name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: One of my least favorite ads from last night:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Are you sick and tired of seeing these expensive ads from tax prep giants?

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1920%2E4032634%2E-OkAuH)
---
What did you think of last night’s ads? With me being a senator from Massachusetts, you can probably guess which one was my personal favorite. One of my least favorites, though? Intuit TurboTax spent millions to run another Super Bowl ad bragging about how their product makes it fast and easy to file your taxes. But they failed to mention one big piece of information: They’ve also spent millions of dollars lobbying to make the tax-filing process as difficult and time-consuming as possible. All to create more demand for their product. All to pad their profits. And all at the expense of Americans who spend an average of $240 and 13 hours to file their taxes every year. As if that isn’t bad enough, Intuit has also tricked low-income Americans who are eligible for free filing services into paying for its company’s products. And you know what? Intuit legally can’t advertise TurboTax as “free” anymore because of all the junk fees they’ve sprung on taxpayers. So that Super Bowl ad should have come with a big disclaimer at the end in gigantic print: “This commercial has been subsidized by all the taxpayers who paid for a service that should have been free.” **But there’s good news: the IRS is piloting a truly free Direct File program, starting this tax season. Sure enough, though, tax prep giants like Intuit are lobbying to stop this solution in its tracks.** [**To get free tax filing across the finish line, Washington needs to hear from the American people. If you’re sick and tired of seeing these expensive ads from tax prep giants, add your name to say you agree it should be quick and easy to file your taxes without having to turn to a private company.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-tax/?source=EMZ19I_TAX_E_20240212_V1S1&t=8&akid=1920%2E4032634%2E-OkAuH) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-tax/?source=EMZ19I_TAX_E_20240212_V1S1&t=9&akid=1920%2E4032634%2E-OkAuH)
---
For years and years, I’ve called out giant tax prep corporations for lobbying to keep it an expensive hassle to file your taxes.
I’ve urged the IRS to make free filing a reality — in legislation, in hearings, in letters, in explainers, you name it.
And I haven’t been alone. People like you have raised your voices, too — in petitions, on social media, in messages to elected officials, and more.
Two years ago, Democrats included funding for free tax filing in the Inflation Reduction Act, along with support for the IRS to crack down on wealthy tax cheats.
And starting this year, the pilot program is getting off the ground.
I’m going to stay on this and make sure Americans don’t have to waste time and money with big tax prep corporations.
[**And I’m asking you to stay in this fight by my side. Add your name if you agree it’s long past time for a free federal tax filing program.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-tax/?source=EMZ19I_TAX_E_20240212_V1S1&t=10&akid=1920%2E4032634%2E-OkAuH)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

body:
A former member of the Florida House of Representatives who is the GOP chairman for Lake County and is currently running for U.S. Congress... | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/67e0d056f6ab/running-for-congress-in-my-hometown-13693221?e=00028e5542)
---
[](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=04d18f720d&e=00028e5542)
[**Former Florida lawmaker, U.S. Congressional candidate, endorses James Judge for Congress**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=e4a9a0688f&e=00028e5542)
_A former member of the Florida House of Representatives who is the GOP chairman for Lake County and is currently running for U.S. Congress endorsed James Judge in his bid to unseat incumbent Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL)._
DADE CITY, Fla. – Anthony Sabatini, a Republican former state legislator in Florida, endorsed James Judge Monday in Judge’s primary bid to unseat Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL) in Florida’s 12th Congressional District.
Sabatini served as a State Representative in Florida’s 32nd District from 2018 to 2022, and he is currently running for the U.S. House of Representatives in Florida’s 11th Congressional District in a primary race against incumbent Daniel Webster (R-FL).
Sabatini is an attorney, Army Veteran, Florida National Guardsman and chairman of the Lake County Republican Party.
“Congressional candidates who want to truly address the issues that matter to Floridians, and frankly all Americans, need to band together and support each other,” said Sabatini. “That’s why I’m proud to endorse James Judge in his race against Gus Bilirakis. Just like my opponent, Gus is the very embodiment of the term ‘career politician.’ It’s time for these uniparty politicians to be retired and for younger patriots to step up and repair the damage they have allowed to happen.”
Sabatini cited Judge’s positions on the economy and immigration as the primary reasons for his endorsement.
“James and I not only share in a fraternal brotherhood as veterans, but we share the same positions on the state of our economy and the urgent need to secure our wide-open border,” said Sabatini. “The current Republican Congress isn’t getting the job done. They’re sending money we don’t have oversees and burying the next generations in debt. They haven’t meaningfully opposed Joe Biden’s open border in any way. If they can’t, or won’t take action to solve these pressing problems, it is time for them to step aside and make way for people who will, like James and I.”
**About James Judge:** James Judge, a Florida native, graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based public relations, marketing and consulting firm. Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner. The Judges live on a ranch in Dade City, with their five dogs, three cats, chickens, cows, goats and horses. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also longtime, active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Lutz.

But what she doesn't have is a rolodex filled with Hollywood billionaires and Wall Street bigwigs cutting big checks like her left-wing opponent does.

And that's why I'm reaching out to you today.

I'm doing everything I can to support Mazi and keep this seat red. I have to -- _**our House Majority depends on it.**_

I've contributed to her, I've asked Republican members of Congress to contribute to her, and now I'm asking you.

I know you care deeply about defending our Democratic Senate majority _._

**That's why I'm bringing you an important update from Montana, where my friend Sen. Jon Tester is in a toss-up race that could determine which party controls the Senate – and a dangerous new GOP opponent just entered the race against him.**

He farms the same land that his grandparents homesteaded 100 years ago. He knows what issues matter to Montanans and he strives to move the needle for them. He is committed to his home state – fighting for the people of Montana in everything he does.
In fact, I've personally worked with Jon on legislation in the Senate to help our nation's veterans. I've witnessed firsthand how hard Jon works to get things done. Losing his compassion and tenacity would be a loss for our country, and it would almost certainly impede Democrats' ability to hold the Senate.

**That's why this moment is so important: A new Republican opponent jumped into the race against Sen. Tester, extremist Matt Rosendale, and virtually every election forecaster is saying this Senate race is a _toss-up. _Both Republican challengers are MAGA-Montanans competing for the votes of the most extreme members of their party and the attention of its leader.**
With Republican super PACs already planning to spend big against Jon, I'm reaching out to this team to help him fight back against this new opponent and the outrageous GOP spending in the state – and to _keep_ Jon in the Senate and defend our Democratic Senate majority.
**[So please, at this critical moment, will you split a donation of $5 between my campaign and Jon Tester's in Montana to keep this battleground state blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78895069/454828959/258718672?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1364-bu-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzI1MTQyMzItMTJjYS1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=o5m73-yUyP3fvn5o02BzCy3gltRdOygPZvGv5wJdlJA=)**

Dick

body:
Issues False Statement Directly Contradicted By Court Documents | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/cd9466332460/joanna-weiss-threatens-lawsuit-to-silence-survivors-of-sexual-abuse-15670384?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** February 12, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Joanna Weiss Threatens Lawsuit To Silence Survivors Of Sexual Abuse
Issues False Statement Directly Contradicted By Court Documents**

_“Jason Weiss has never defended a priest. All legal options are being considered to address this actionable defamation.”
\- Joanna Weiss 2.12.24

“Jason Weiss also acted as lead attorney for the diocese in a widely publicized abuse case from 2017. In that lawsuit, defendant “Jane Doe” claimed that the Diocese of Orange knowingly abetted child sexual abuse and grooming, covering for a priest who was named in credible sexual misconduct allegations.”
-The Daily Beast 1.18.24_ **IRVINE, CA** — Today, the controversy from the [Daily Beast’s](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=120c2ace92&e=7017cc100e) shocking investigative report on CA-47 candidate Joanna Weiss’ self-financing of her campaign with over $230,000 earned representing the Catholic Church against sex abuse, child molestation and sexual assault claims in Orange County took an ugly turn as Joanna Weiss personally threatened a lawsuit and issued a provably false statement.

The statement and threat by Weiss follow a disturbing pattern of behavior which was described to the Daily Beast as [“aggressive”](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=6af5bb30ca&e=7017cc100e) and [“hurtful.”](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=de188d67a2&e=7017cc100e) They also contradict a news story by [Politico](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5febff7f58&e=7017cc100e), in which Joanna Weiss’ campaign pushed back on the Daily Beast’s findings stating that Weiss “primarily represented the [Catholic] diocese on employment matters.”

**“The Weiss’s should stick to defending the Catholic Church and pedophile priests instead of threatening lawsuits and attempting to silence survivors and advocates,”** said Dan Driscoll, Campaign Manager. **“The court documents categorically prove that Joanna Weiss is lying through her teeth. Dave Min is proud to stand with survivors of abuse and will not be bullied or lied to by these fraudsters.”**
**Here Are The Receipts Of Jason Weiss Defending Pedophile Priests** **“Lawsuit accuses O.C. priest of sexually assaulting his assistant at Irvine church”**
**\- Los Angeles 7.20.2017** In 2018, Weiss acted as the lead attorney defending the Catholic Church in the highly publicized case alleging that the Diocese of Orange knowingly covered up and abetted child grooming and sexual assault by one of its priests, who had previously been the subject of sexual misconduct claims dating back over a decade. Weiss argued that the First Amendment’s protections for**** freedom of religion [shielded the Church from liability](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=0a9c414c4b&e=7017cc100e). After this argument was rejected, the Diocese of Orange [settled the case](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d4ffc08e2e&e=7017cc100e).
**“All of California’s 12 Bishops Sued for Alleged Clergy Abuse Cover-Up”
\- The Daily Beast 10/08/2018**
Again in 2018, Weiss acted as the lead attorney defending the Catholic Church in a highly publicized case alleging that the Church knowingly covered up and abetted child sex abuse and rape by one of its lead priests in the Diocese of Orange. Weiss represented the Diocese of Orange through multiple years of this litigation, [including on appeal](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=b07a200323&e=7017cc100e).
**“California's institutions face a flood of sexual abuse lawsuits”
\- The Los Angeles Times 12/28/22**
In 2020, Jason Weiss was [lead attorney](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=6a10b63438&e=7017cc100e) for The Roman Catholic Bishop Of Orange against a lawsuit alleging sexual abuse by Rev. Thomas Naughton, whom the Church ‘relocated to Southern California’ after earlier accusations of sexual misconduct. John Doe 54’s [lawsuit](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c5085f326e&e=7017cc100e) claimed that Fr. Naughton committed ‘acts of childhood sexual assault’ against him from approximately ages nine through 16, including ‘sexual touching, humiliation, masturbation, and anal penetration.’ We have experienced multiple recent social movements that are making different conversations and change possible, including the Ford-Kavanaugh hearing, #WhyIDidn’t Report, Times Up, and #MeToo movements. Weiss dismissing Weiss' representation of the Catholic Church against child sexual assault survivors as mere employment matters further victimizes these courageous survivors. Sen. Dave Min not only stands with survivors, but has authored and passed 8 bills expanding abuse survivors rights and protections, recently introduced a bill protecting adult survivors of clerical abuse, and will soon introduce two more domestic violence bills. ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

_**What are your core values?**_ It's a question that every person should ask themselves as we begin this new year.

In Congress, too many politicians are driven by greed and power.

_But that will never be me._

I served our country as a Green Beret, and _the same values I held every day fighting for our freedom abroad I still hold in Washington D.C. every day._

I'm going tell your about which values are most important to me, and I hope you'll take a moment to reflect on the values YOU bring to the ballot box when you vote.

**So, let 's start with one of the most important virtues you need in leadership: _sacrifice_. **

Serving as a Green Beret, I had to put my own needs and impulses to the side for the good of our country.

I spent many birthdays, holidays, and celebrations away from my family on the other side of the world.

_It was tough, but I wouldn 't trade it for anything. _

Too many politicians today have never sacrificed anything.

They're motivated by self interest, not the interests of our country.

**Let me be clear: I will always put service to my country and my constituents over my own personal gain.**

**[I'm on a mission to bring more leaders to Washington who put service over self, but I need your help. Can you pitch in now and help us win for real leaders?](http://links.myfreedomnews.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=276ac4803222451eaee68b7f35e6dcd2&_e=ggILlh-oCAyLxOQqJceMz_pXH9ISSea7Sd9VVWpLxrTf7X6PPzU3clobwo7p9l9XNWH87e-zMfOCcgS5uEaTQBKVSO2N7Is2o1lTWZWr27fwAut8onW6CUvgqVQOeZ4NlvBkFomo4r_agVHi001mDVHw2Z033FR_CSLcLqIQjFpYr_v3eDUib7caWXq2WKEkYtn7uxVHv_yHbftq0CSjxcqdkzAFotMaPs5GsyjKGDcOmH2UpVLp_YtLs8auXc_wKJtD7cGliu9oYrx_TWU-udotKpxnopxJ-zrJcrsK-SQ%3D)**

clean_body: | | | What are your core values? It's a question that every person should ask themselves as we begin this new year. In Congress, too many politicians are driven by greed and power. But that will never be me. I served our country as a Green Beret, and the same values I held every day fighting for our freedom abroad I still hold in Washington D.C. every day. I'm going tell your about which values are most important to me, and I hope you'll take a moment to reflect on the values YOU bring to the ballot box when you vote. So, let 's start with one of the most important virtues you need in leadership: sacrifice. Serving as a Green Beret, I had to put my own needs and impulses to the side for the good of our country. Thank you for your dedication and commitment to our cause. Together, we can make history!

Deepfake technology was on full display during the recent elections in Pakistan, as jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan was able to rally support for his party with the assistance of artificial intelligence. Through the use of AI-powered voice cloning, he was able to disseminate his message to millions from behind bars.
Last week, I noted in a piece titled "[Elections 2024: Can Democracy Endure?](https://substack.com/redirect/7d003ebf-4c7f-438b-88f4-76894f3b4661?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" that many Pakistanis believed that Khan had been the target of the establishment that created fictional corruption charges to put Khan behind bars. Meanwhile, former Prime Minister Nawaz Sherif, who had been convicted of corruption charges returned from self-imposed exile to courts that overturned their prior rulings.

#### [Elections 2024: Can Democracy Endure?](https://substack.com/redirect/7d003ebf-4c7f-438b-88f4-76894f3b4661?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
Lots of ordinary citizens on the streets believed democracy in Pakistan has been hijacked by the military and elites and that they were weaponizing the powers of the government to attack a political opponent. The public began describing the process as a "selection" rather than an election. Khan's party was expected to lose out to the military's preferred party, The Pakistan Muslim League (Nawaz).
But then, according to the _New York Times_ ,
> _[As official counts showed candidates aligned with his party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), winning the most seats in a surprise result that threw the country's political system into chaos, it was Mr. Khans's AI voice that declared victory. "I had full confidence that you would all come out to vote. You fulfilled my faith in you, and your massive turnout has stunned everybody," the mellow, slightly robotic voice said in the minute-long video, which used historical images and footage of Mr. Khan and bore a disclaimer about its AI origins.](https://substack.com/redirect/e96191da-ef2f-4aed-bd65-c22d49ecc950?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
The _New York Times_ went on to praise Khan's use of AI to combat voter suppression but also quoted Toby Walsh, author of the forthcoming _[Faking It: Artificial Intelligence in a Human World](https://substack.com/redirect/152a5ba0-1b26-491c-a78f-8a7b0d66fe1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , as noting that "at the same time, it's undermining our belief in the things we hear and see."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/768f68a4-1cc6-44d0-b8b3-a1dd01853eaa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Pakistani ex-prime minister Imran Khan, as seen on a computer screen in the city of Karachi last week. Though in jail, he has managed to speak to his supporters courtesy of an A.I.-generated voice. Credit...Akhtar Soomro/Reuters; Source: [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/02/11/world/asia/imran-khan-artificial-intelligence-pakistan.html](https://substack.com/redirect/e96191da-ef2f-4aed-bd65-c22d49ecc950?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's also important to note that [Pakistan's literacy rate (percentage of citizens over 19 years of age who are proficient in reading and writing) is around 58%](https://substack.com/redirect/0ffaa75e-49d6-4136-83aa-4b3886c1d0d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This means 42% of the population would be unable to read newspaper stories or pamphlets promoting one party or candidate over another. [For comparison, the United States literacy rate is 79%](https://substack.com/redirect/a462807d-366e-4246-9a11-92addc70f3d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This means audio and video content has a disproportionately large impact in a country like Pakistan.
Deepfakes are not just turning up in Pakistan. They also surfaced this weekend in Indonesia, where one of the political parties generated a [deepfake video of Indonesia's second president, former General Suharto](https://substack.com/redirect/afc07493-840d-44ab-8ea3-a79fa6f4279a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to highlight the importance of the upcoming vote.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/904e0fa5-47ee-4b7d-b55b-a2ba7041e613?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
An AI-generated deepfake of the late dictator Suharto has sparked debate about using AI technology for political gain.Erwin Aksa/X; Source: [https://www.cnn.com/2024/02/12/asia/suharto-deepfake-ai-scam-indonesia-election-hnk-intl/index.html](https://substack.com/redirect/93552d9c-944c-44e6-b3fa-ca03a75118a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Let's not forget that Indonesia is the world's largest muslim nation and has approximately 200 million registered voters. Reaching (and influencing) even a small percentage can change results of an election. And, according to CNN, "[the online world plays a huge role in Indonesian politics. In a country with on elf the world's highest Internet usage rates, almost all political parties and politicians maintain strong presences on social media to amass followers and clout](https://substack.com/redirect/93552d9c-944c-44e6-b3fa-ca03a75118a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
When the stakes are high, contenders for the top job will use every tool at their disposal, and artificial intelligence is proving to be a seductive option. The campaign team of Defense Minister Prabowo Subianto, a leading candidate in the upcoming election, recently admitted to using AI to "[give their chief a cuddly animated makeover on TikTok to appeal to young voters...[because] Indonesians aged 40 and younger -- who number around 114 million voters -- make up a majority of votes.](https://substack.com/redirect/93552d9c-944c-44e6-b3fa-ca03a75118a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" The campaign also used AI-generated children in videos to avoid tripping on legal restrictions that ban the use of children in political commercials. Meanwhile, the other campaigns are using AI-powered chatbots to engage voters.
And lest we think such AI-powered campaigning is constrained to faraway elections taking place in emerging markets, time to think again. In late January, a deepfake audio of President Joe Biden encouraged potential voters to stay home during the New Hampshire primary, and the audio was distributed by traditional robocalls.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c23e497b-740e-46ee-bdf2-3ee488ca75e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-01-26/ai-startup-elevenlabs-bans-account-blamed-for-biden-audio-deepfake](https://substack.com/redirect/3816aed7-747d-431a-9ba7-3b933f913e55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); Photographer: Ting Shen/Bloomberg
## _So What?_
The increasing use of deepfake technologies presents huge challenges to individuals and society alike. Our human capabilities are not suited to question the authenticity of images and sounds that appear familiar. Deepfakes create a disorienting perception of reality that erodes our belief in any objective truth. The mental strain of dealing with such dynamics is enormous, and may, as I suggested in [my annual set of predictions](https://substack.com/redirect/5bcad96d-3453-45c9-b31c-cf21f8467df0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), compound an already problematic mental health crisis as everyone starts viewing every piece of information with suspicion. But their impact on elections is likely to be visible soon.
A _Wall Street Journal_ essay titled "[The Deepfake Dangers Ahead](https://substack.com/redirect/6749b2e7-d1d6-416b-a867-3f556cf1ccb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" described what such suspicion might practically mean: "[soldiers might not trust actual orders, and public may think that genuine scandals and outrages aren't real. A climate of pervasive suspicion will allow politicians and their supporters to dismiss anything negative that is reported about them as fake or exaggerated](https://substack.com/redirect/6749b2e7-d1d6-416b-a867-3f556cf1ccb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Henry Farid, a professor at the University of California who studies digital propaganda misinformation, has called suggested that deepfakes have created a "liars dividend" that provides wrong doers caught on video or audio with "plausible deniability."
One of the most memorable movie scenes from my childhood was of a little girl ominously describing the arrival of a paranormal disturbance with a concise phrase that is as memorable today as it was when the movie was released in 1982: "They're heeere!" The movie, _Poltergeist_ , was based on a story by Steven Spielberg and was remade in 2015.
Well, it seems we can use the same phrase to describe the ominous arrival of deepfake technologies into our modern world. **They 're heeere!** And they're unlikely to go anywhere soon. Time to get ready for a world where you question everything you hear and see, with major implications for individuals, politics, democracy and society at large.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f724c057-db62-4d6f-88a9-87fe19fa695f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Deepfakes create a disorienting perception of reality that erodes our belief in any objective truth. The mental strain of dealing with such dynamics is enormous, and may, as I suggested in , compound an already problematic mental health crisis as everyone starts viewing every piece of information with suspicion. But their impact on elections is likely to be visible soon. A Wall Street Journal essay titled "" described what such suspicion might practically mean: "." Henry Farid, a professor at the University of California who studies digital propaganda misinformation, has called suggested that deepfakes have created a "liars dividend" that provides wrong doers caught on video or audio with "plausible deniability." One of the most memorable movie scenes from my childhood was of a little girl ominously describing the arrival of a paranormal disturbance with a concise phrase that is as memorable today as it was when the movie was released in 1982: "They're heeere!" The movie, Poltergeist , was based on a story by Steven Spielberg and was remade in 2015. Well, it seems we can use the same phrase to describe the ominous arrival of deepfake technologies into our modern world. They 're heeere! And they're unlikely to go anywhere soon. Time to get ready for a world where you question everything you hear and see, with major implications for individuals, politics, democracy and society at large. Appendix: Are You Ready For Deepfakes? As a self-described pracademic, I pride myself on combining practical analysis with academic rigor before analyzing the implications and consequences or potential developments. Given the rapidly advancing capability of deepfake audio and video technology, I wanted to experiment to see if I could recreate audio that sounds like me. Please vote in the poll below. (I promise to reveal the truth next week!) Self-taught to think around corners and connect original dots, he spends his time speaking with global leaders in business, government, academia, and journalism. LinkedIn has twice listed him as its #1 Top Voice in Money & Finance, and Worth profiled him as one of the 100 Most Powerful People in Global Finance. Vikram earned a PhD From MIT, has taught at Yale and Harvard, and is the author of two books, and . subject: Our course on the American Founding—Now on DVD
body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6nqe400qfd2c8cmfke54gikeenq7pd9s88722ug_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c3h64o30cdh2bs)
---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z70t079biqtb2q7nhiche6gu4rf3cjbdr3ncrv78_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c3h64o30cdh2bs)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

subject: Watch the trailer for our newest course, “The Exodus Story”
body:
The story of how God used Moses to lead the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39147%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=R7aUvTRv2MIHyLeWBivg4Q&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear Friend,

The Biblical story of **Exodus** is fundamentally important to Christianity and Judaism, as well as to understanding Western Civilization.

The story of how God used Moses to lead the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt, followed by 40 years in the desert in pursuit of the promised land, reveals **a profound truth about human liberty and man’s place in God’s creation.**

**These will be the main themes addressed in Hillsdale College’s latest free online course, “The Exodus Story,” which will be released on February 13.**

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39148%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7UOuFnodZHQY1wgxZEpTsA&sysid=1)
As you know, Hillsdale refuses to accept one penny of government funding, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. Our work is entirely dependent on the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

**Will you consider helping us meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on February 13 so we can promote this new online course effectively?**

With your tax-deductible gift, we can enroll additional tens of thousands of Americans in “The Exodus Story,” as well as expand Hillsdale’s other educational outreach efforts.

Please help us reach our **$500,000 goal**. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your gift below:

Larry P. Arnn

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

body:

| | | This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=91c2b43670cd495980f0d97b0025128f&_e=fTyXG1TKdSFKN5Z-QGEsxKN-Zrwkeq_114ydghsz8NSTR1HrLXeHdt26YnXN9JNFgp758V_lHyvVe4h8d1dGK66M4eKNU-796naZK8DTLoZ5YGdcgBW0BXUa33PJB3ew2kxvtMM_qprRnAt3Q9J2DiBPdbaOG_vetY4ucP_HF1w841D1UKruR7UDlziBvxsaXhDX5onuHJ3zz9nKFRu2TSn__sfuWn5dPcVlkKSkFYT3UlCcZARf5Ld_KfbdXKaf-0cwdlO_dOyu49rZ178egpYPseGGLFRnw5oHB0NhWhGhY9nPR__xfZJ8QV4wfKN6sfbEtC1ag29rRh3N6aSIDZHVfD8gfoXDoUmrUlRmAT8oj3SKCCaRPRmrNrZFNFyA6-wbXsc8MYTf26ytLF4dVmTTu77xSyBR_u_5FTbkWn20S_XwPXyAjS-sVGIokHAb)

Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

## Biden Joins "National Security Threat" TikTok
President Biden's presidential campaign joined the [Chinese-owned social media app](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2Yzss4FkYOjClq4d0dk-k2uMjcANyr-v0rnzJ33v6X3d5hty4rx84kpjjWVGX_lJM0htJNjZNmGMRECmoVEPargYe1W2uY8hXvBqnLuSd_0AoY8aKaIyirDD4BoeQYFVoI1WXQ9Dq6HTHXlCP7gh2k5YRYFr2dvvwrneKaZXedLe-rI2abzXuh3CfAiYBEznebbZ-Uzn8d4FTFtJXNkfAqY3SFIiX7lkAZPjQFl6XDfkJcv3_SErP2p5yANfnBd5lp8UcpW7z6jNxfS22cewnZwSH_0grFpW5PTnUv8t8xsAAP__NNBm-g) TikTok, walking back a 2023 promise of opposition to the app. The Biden administration previously called TikTok a national security threat and banned federal employees from using it on government-owned devices. Nonetheless, Biden made his first TikTok post on Super Bowl Sunday in a video titled "lol hey guys" under the username @bidenhq. [You can see it here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOszAQhJ8GOiN7sWNSUPwp6PJfeSUy9hI2MTaynSDe_sTVV30jjTQzmu_7eDfkKTz-mxX7MsfR2EIfHIGJloEcZe36GRGwrbEXmuuulVcu66VXc-e0hpmDMui6CTTCFXASplXQKVVTDxwkB9EKri6gGwFKKLRorJ70LFUlOToqMTXPSKEsOPsjfjA1Nq6175dStly1_yoYKhj2fW_WHE6vggEDe-cKhoD7iS16KmRP6aNnCx7s8T4y2xJmchgKm06wsyezQq8SX8xh3qggy2jficrBbAwWUzhTTGK3myDz5Z516t22k_eUL7qS_LEa8r8Ty5-H_QQAAP__1lVu0Q) Campaign officials justified the policy reversal as a political necessity, saying, "The campaign will continue meeting voters where they are."

Remington, the nation's oldest gun manufacturer, will close its factory in Llion, NY, [and move to Georgia](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAQQH-N3RENw5ddUFyTLtdeaZHx4HCLIcIkUf79Kltv-fSap_fvslxCyqlsf8POvse6BOrpyQsKqQTqRY-rj8zIamQvHbhJ6Rn0ePNINIdIZoooLaCajLMTkzWOpVHXeUweATWgVBKMRXeSaKRh4kDu6qI2gwZeU6_t9L-m0m8c87s-uZ2o7mP2t97vx6D-DHge8BzuhV_HR32g9USZBzwXfol3bV-i8Z7K1msR26OIGKjX9haU6_FoLObZRaskKqsjgGGcDQKupCYCMEGNza_3V8o5HdYNGrY9pPzT0X-98h0AAP__oc5hgQ) after 200 years of producing firearms in the Mohawk Valley. clean_body: The Kansas City Chiefs beat the San Francisco 49ers in overtime, winning their second straight Super Bowl by a score of 25-22. | | | | | | TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 13, 2024 ---|--- Good Morning! On this day in 2000, the final original "Peanuts" comic strip was published in newspapers. Creator Charles Schultz died the day before, but he had already drawn this last strip saying goodbye. () Speaking of Peanuts, today's Flyover Poll asks what your favorite classic newspaper comic strip was. We could only list six for space, but if you have a favorite that's not included, let us know by hitting reply and sending us your choice. In case you haven't signed up for The Flyover yet, you can do that here . Today's edition is brought to you by our friends at . | Biden Joins "National Security Threat" TikTok President Biden's presidential campaign joined the TikTok, walking back a 2023 promise of opposition to the app. The Biden administration previously called TikTok a national security threat and banned federal employees from using it on government-owned devices. Nonetheless, Biden made his first TikTok post on Super Bowl Sunday in a video titled "lol hey guys" under the username @bidenhq. Campaign officials justified the policy reversal as a political necessity, saying, "The campaign will continue meeting voters where they are." Iconic Gun Maker Set to Leave NY for Georgia Remington, the nation's oldest gun manufacturer, will close its factory in Llion, NY, after 200 years of producing firearms in the Mohawk Valley. Remington CEO Ken D'Arcy of New York as a core reason for the plant's closure in early March. D'Arcy's position is similar to one given by Smith & Wesson when they left Massachusetts for Tennessee in 2021. Remington will that officials claim dates back to World War I and has become too expensive to maintain and insure. Also left behind will be a community that has been tied to Remington for generations. Police Identify Osteen Church Shooter Police offered new details Monday on the shooter at televangelist Joel Osteen's megachurch in Houston who was killed by two off-duty officers on Sunday. The shooter was identified as a long criminal record. Police said Moreno used multiple aliases of both men and women. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=70fb4fb9eaf14429b65d614547b02bee&_e=5ZBQ1GiPMEn7rtSQiDOjIObfQTrT75xlt5xZA9At3Ks70MIZLJNOFZrGp5RFRIwza5ZY-7Z7x3E32JgvFlVvpggrGR8yoPC5H98BqIoQ_aqOZ5835TpBIpiIdfPTqlpLlSDinwOz26_vrbG61yfbXdKMz_9-lKSIVlcLM93YcL4iYnf2gw7EFOzLU91HMlUw3dcONCocjWb0HZBQMf7LhnwLFldG5cz7rf2owsrWXUfdgeSYyPtJ7RaaAvrmNajQmiop1e0hFTapR79-3DKXva37i5lkV_5r9GMXTabnGuTfGPKVbX7n09t7VXF26o-lh7YE-sJ7gR7spxaEMCBKAfW3mjeXSQh8J46ybx3UbMpBlMUSdqTlIuOG1z8nlYk02y3aA4B6LxkBRvL4jNDHDA%3D%3D)

| | Dear Friend,

The Biblical story of **Exodus** is fundamentally important to Christianity and Judaism, as well as to understanding Western Civilization.

The story of how God used Moses to lead the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt, followed by 40 years in the desert in pursuit of the promised land, reveals **a profound truth about human liberty and man 's place in God's creation.**

**These will be the main themes addressed in Hillsdale College 's latest free online course, "The Exodus Story," which will be released on February 13.**

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=70fb4fb9eaf14429b65d614547b02bee&_e=5ZBQ1GiPMEn7rtSQiDOjIObfQTrT75xlt5xZA9At3Ks70MIZLJNOFZrGp5RFRIwza5ZY-7Z7x3E32JgvFlVvpggrGR8yoPC5H98BqIoQ_aqOZ5835TpBIpiIdfPTqlpLlSDinwOz26_vrbG61yfbXdKMz_9-lKSIVlcLM93YcL4iYnf2gw7EFOzLU91HMlUw3dcONCocjWb0HZBQMf7LhnwLFldG5cz7rf2owsrWXUfc86YshLrOt8tCkEsJNLatxLKmZmctGqxAaX_TtiooohBYGVSe0CNbvGqobjoZlKyaDs0Y_BaLIPaW4SWHWGCnodXJCmFwMJG4l-c_cw-4l2W8MFQmlkJygcE3ddULmLwp3xH8WdLr4KLNgK9AfT8Dh_glVszfb3QfQ1_31_Sw_g%3D%3D)
As you know, Hillsdale refuses to accept one penny of government funding, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. Our work is entirely dependent on the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

**Will you consider helping us meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on February 13 so we can promote this new online course effectively?**

With your tax-deductible gift, we can enroll additional tens of thousands of Americans in "The Exodus Story," as well as expand Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts.

Please help us reach our **$500,000 goal**. I've included a secure link for you to make your gift below:

[**https://online.hillsdale.edu/prereg/exodus**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=70fb4fb9eaf14429b65d614547b02bee&_e=5ZBQ1GiPMEn7rtSQiDOjIObfQTrT75xlt5xZA9At3Ks70MIZLJNOFZrGp5RFRIwza5ZY-7Z7x3E32JgvFlVvpggrGR8yoPC5H98BqIoQ_aqOZ5835TpBIpiIdfPTqlpLlSDinwOz26_vrbG61yfbXdKMz_9-lKSIVlcLM93YcL4iYnf2gw7EFOzLU91HMlUw3dcONCocjWb0HZBQMf7LhnwLFldG5cz7rf2owsrWXUdOm-UgrX9ktcE51HeVebq09qgmUAPRHKfIxMUF4T4g1Sh2o8HeipZIT39m8-Ws4N5au0A5T0CUBxp0pAn_PXgPc6eXOcpb41DEriXfvaIUxtAvCsLoEngw4K6BjTTtDUybiRK2cPSuTByCmKxnsQWINk7HnEjgfg-sqFNJ609Tgw%3D%3D)

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

The Biblical story of **Exodus** is fundamentally important to Christianity and Judaism, as well as to understanding Western Civilization.

The story of how God used Moses to lead the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt, followed by 40 years in the desert in pursuit of the promised land, reveals **a profound truth about human liberty and man 's place in God's creation.**

**These will be the main themes addressed in Hillsdale College 's latest free online course, "The Exodus Story," which will be released on February 13.**

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=555949f4fef94ac7ba4fd8fa22ffe66a&_e=6oqct4QJboih6wxhxxNMC_7nIUZO3Jycick_P8gmhXGkkQe-vITgt37hKq55aIqBYqHyBLynt5Ghm6_k9hphvn8xN8AENiJBHm3I6Nio0PvpSRyEPIhi-YRw_NrmKuMDalo0vhHiwLnXnUIuaEqeNbmY_VXeSsRJ0Ew2RrO84mMY37ASSDHcmNjVzLIyTp7LaVa8YNz5XdyqYhS_afYvu8LUPY5EIg9ZBRZYSX96OtVQWeLpt15byTjsDNNM1HKzEYTYAjmNnS1LMeXp2TUTCgeZVVZZXV2rn2sj5liJ6r3ApCrSDoyEzJL-pthZ3YZoPE9XNecNoDaJgkfSC861h-u21ra-bMnXZIDA51PiDeDkglzJZ0fCUJj7zhsdvrXLU7_Dyq4-w82PdmoO7gSlyQ%3D%3D)
As you know, Hillsdale refuses to accept one penny of government funding, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. Our work is entirely dependent on the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

**Will you consider helping us meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on February 13 so we can promote this new online course effectively?**

With your tax-deductible gift, we can enroll additional tens of thousands of Americans in "The Exodus Story," as well as expand Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts.

Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=134e0f5826f64243b29b1caf956dceb8&_e=v_x8Ag0iVDnuDChGLVQdROEDfXFMwV257jm2KqOXkQQCxEB9THHBjiZ9p3q0b6TnMchZa7qqSgwQn28pKLyaHrfJxtrA_dbi2bjkCQagGt-kpMWux--KmjB__ipYEzaXDN9MV2EgpJsT63FFDEppuWFEe7ZTdPFiK1sgso1HsmnwJ2AZogx6nR416WSyXsflMBWKQF0szSRPP3hNiYsGZrxyoshKlJ3EranzCMQm_3dQ5-iFpORvtAYWSOKqG-qk1Zl-jZDHsAYBwh69IUTsYwU747GPBh2d8cYB0NDAkowjoa9I73isiZpZsJR4dp--fBcpOnoFx3PiW4C62g0QADBB4m7qRVIcNBQmazFxXuNc81Tk2AqstKvMrbrHrWueh5mtHQtGNGw79QCtOMcwXPMnXdQBX5NESNeLyhBCeyb58frQ-O4zogV7KTN7cjhC)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible. Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course? And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for " The Real American Founding: A Conversation," by clicking the link below. I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College | | Reclaiming American Freedom PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522

| Senate Special Committee on Investigations On Friday, the Senate Special Committee on Investigations held its first meeting - where lawmakers revealed that whistleblowers had come forward from the Fulton County DA's office to testify about District Attorney Fani Willis.
According to the Senators, several whistleblowers allege misuse of federal and state funds - in addition to the conflict of interest allegations that will be heard by a court later this week. Earlier this month, Willis admitted to having an affair with Nathan Wade - the prosecutor she chose to lead the grand jury investigation into President Trump.
The Senate Special Committee has subpoena power and the authority to compel documents and testimony. It will conduct interviews and author a report on its findings, as well as recommend changes to state law to improve transparency for local prosecutors. As State Senator Bill Cowsert (SD-46) emphasized, "This is not a political witch hunt; this is a quest for the truth." To read more about the first meeting, [CLICK HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YbdqIGW18bFfo9GGkH9ZhWTEL80BITrsY_zWtV5o4xR5gsbizg7x0k5okeV_rH9CFRYLO7fqb_I4BaqAaiHOvvg182JtyyQE6lBgTybiXZYnRRG4MsujEkNMmJ0zVgskgfEu4K4lKId4xJDX76qDF_8FHzaZn6_uSwGvJyAa-mQPDcYF2jIPRPjDZw1lA2iApr_nRdxZ_I4d0-fOYhBmzo5byjguGr6j4C3N5SFzSkviGPnoMnNXl0SLcfkMwmfWDlnDqOImtlo=&c=ygcqYtIK_2vA3pdLEU8DS8dghN2y6R0XFlUu2ieN3Tc1Q7TYi79UBg==&ch=eh7wxG_W8jYfspCYTKYV08mqX4w0Q2jDh6op0dzopzMC08QaoGJ7gg==).
Mid-Year 2024 Budget The State House passed a $37.5B mid-year budget with $5B in new spending. Highlights include $1.5B for transportation, $1,000 teacher bonuses, and funding for new medical schools at the University of Georgia and Georgia Southern University. ### Senator Randy Robertson (SD-29)
Senator Randy Robertson serves the 29th Senate District which encompasses Troup, Meriwether, Harris, and Muscogee Counties. He is the Majority Whip and serves as Vice Chairman of the Public Safety Committee. He also serves as a member of the Appropriations, Government Oversight, Insurance and Labor, and Redistricting Committees. Senator Robertson has sponsored several key pieces of legislation this session including a bill to eliminate no-cash bail (SB63), a bill to amend the Prosecuting Attorneys Qualifications Commission (SB332), and a bill to ban ranked-choice voting (SB355).

We've got an incredible lineup of speakers - including State Rep. Mesha Mainor, Albany City Commissioner Jalen Johnson, Let's Win for America Chairman Kelvin King, and Blexit State Director Michaelah Montgomery - plus free food and drinks. Status: Received Final Passage | | | Other News to Know | == | Senate Special Committee on Investigations On Friday, the Senate Special Committee on Investigations held its first meeting - where lawmakers revealed that whistleblowers had come forward from the Fulton County DA's office to testify about District Attorney Fani Willis. According to the Senators, several whistleblowers allege misuse of federal and state funds - in addition to the conflict of interest allegations that will be heard by a court later this week. Earlier this month, Willis admitted to having an affair with Nathan Wade - the prosecutor she chose to lead the grand jury investigation into President Trump. The Senate Special Committee has subpoena power and the authority to compel documents and testimony. It will conduct interviews and author a report on its findings, as well as recommend changes to state law to improve transparency for local prosecutors. As State Senator Bill Cowsert (SD-46) emphasized, "This is not a political witch hunt; this is a quest for the truth." To read more about the first meeting, ==. Mid-Year 2024 Budget The State House passed a $37.5B mid-year budget with $5B in new spending. Highlights include $1.5B for transportation, $1,000 teacher bonuses, and funding for new medical schools at the University of Georgia and Georgia Southern University. He is the Majority Whip and serves as Vice Chairman of the Public Safety Committee. He also serves as a member of the Appropriations, Government Oversight, Insurance and Labor, and Redistricting Committees. Senator Robertson has sponsored several key pieces of legislation this session including a bill to eliminate no-cash bail (SB63), a bill to amend the Prosecuting Attorneys Qualifications Commission (SB332), and a bill to ban ranked-choice voting (SB355). To learn more about Senator Robertson, ==. | | Representative Lauren Daniel (HD-117) Representative Lauren Daniel serves the people of Locust Grove in Georgia's 117th House District in Henry County. body:
| | | Friend, My parents grew up in the Jim Crow South. At every turn, they faced hate and discrimination. They were told they were less than because of the color of their skin. **With the help of brave Americans across the country, we dismantled the Jim Crow era. Now, my parents, who had to use "colored" water fountains, have a son who's serving in Washington DC.** **_Only in America could we go from Jim Crow to Congress in one generation, and my family and I are living proof._ **
---
[**DEFEND THE AMERICAN DREAM**](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=c9e63ce463b24ac5acfaf2202c35b602&_e=wsbT2TQ8qwwW5W1E-s1wuC1LNbQjWzt4_UW5qZdjUFElg9_nha4kyydeXK9oxW41bNes-qEfMqqDxtCcdT79vNe_RoL3AFZuPON2BwSMpsKEWrE6Hs6eLvGlsuspVGeO_7hJkq_C4KTydMlavnE9OIWYRL163UYYdwdr3mdcHzfoY1ELcaPaVxt3Fj8_mEfEfp4gYjYxbfAdFHDn2WVyuWTq7NVRoYrolHyWJ4SBu7OPkHpJq9i9tnnrSBEZA6of2FMAqIUiEIierxanNBxAJ0hdoU-6B7x6N5whUT05JqU9z8w06c95YAHVX9cWEqrf0yhFKFg_mQlC7v_vne8HMVm7F9WhJ_6gOEqqLXwoYxxzAdZVsgHkkCBe8PvZPVFW2S7BO5eDR5uKwgOhtsCjqIRIIeQABweQE6eiTuRQDgM%3D)
---
The Left think that because I'm a Republican, I'm not _really_ black. ** ** **Joe Biden certainly thinks so. Just listen to his "you ain't black" or "he's gonna put y'all back in chains" tirades.** ** ** Let me be clear, those statements aren't gaffes, they are indicative of how Democrats _truly_ feel. ** ** **Democrats believe that to be "black" means that you must be dependent on them.******** ** **That is their entire business model. Democrats know that if they can keep black Americans just poor enough to where they 're not starving--that the voters will be dependent on the handouts that the Democrats offer them.
**
I have a message to those Democrats like Biden who say that people like Tim Scott, Thomas Sowell, Clarence Thomas and me "ain't black." _ _ _I 'm a Republican BECAUSE I'm black, not in spite of it. _
* I believe in opportunity for all people regardless of skin color.
* I believe in every American's right to think for themselves.
* I believe in conservative values and economic prosperity.

When I see the woke mob trying to divide us based on where we come from or what we look like, I'm reminded of the segregated society my parents grew up in. That TERRIFIES ME.

The woke mob has created an economy of race hatred that keeps people angry enough to continue to vote for them.

**I 'm dedicated to defeating them.**

America is the land of opportunity, and I ran for Congress because I will do everything in my power to keep it that way.****** ** **[Now, I need your help. I'm a top target for the bigoted Left because my family's story is living proof of what is possible for black Americans. Will you chip in now and help me continue my fight?](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=c9e63ce463b24ac5acfaf2202c35b602&_e=wsbT2TQ8qwwW5W1E-s1wuC1LNbQjWzt4_UW5qZdjUFElg9_nha4kyydeXK9oxW41bNes-qEfMqqDxtCcdT79vNe_RoL3AFZuPON2BwSMpsKEWrE6Hs6eLvGlsuspVGeO_7hJkq_C4KTydMlavnE9OIWYRL163UYYdwdr3mdcHzfoY1ELcaPaVxt3Fj8_mEfEfp4gYjYxbfAdFHDn2WVyuWTq7NVRoYrolHyWJ4SBu7OPkHpJq9i9tnnrSBEZA6of2FMAqIUiEIierxanNBxAJzr7X7dB23RVOZwo2t3vDDvu1f7zydwdrCn-dHngC5mKANGc3uBSJDwadbzxb_6h2OBo758Ud1SQoIbftMm7uKuuo87_z46K7wzf83Rnb7ov8-lYqUj-C__4Di4SDt58xUW0yQ_22Uwmu5Mjb3erxwg%3D)**

Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=54d8dba7a90e4fbe9ee82e76621e8f50&_e=esqGAEmkSeVVncbZdXljy9lRlmibvO4E_W-lefJlxSfb2aCZ51oliNhmh9oGrVJNKOhphGc0VH3MJiOQA-RSsDSHthRUjOCthJ2j5vB428GS7olqt8NJlX4Ls4W7LRhW7gVAgoGza5woizk4eawUvlbJyL_K50pk_NI9sfJumYqZKmUzE6rpYBcJnFNYuklZez9Mmc2Tl9v3qjfwK2DCsdv3XPSTbEUQB7DM5DcU1NzeTjNMo1QCpLXG9DQ83NIZ4-pGL69pdc30RyzhiO_MBwS-0F_0_nHAxquYPvf4-8G8cD-Z7LHEPGwIBOlezenHtKGEv3gkYQuFH-22LNMihN9yAbEvmMawZ1rMo8PQPnAMKidxTypFwMsWN_wJqEYGj5u4bFjjm6rsYXBJALSY4VXbLwuJB4z8w89JnCR26mP8FtjJcdIuwpTeXsJmWOST)

clean_body: Friends, Deciding where your duty lies - family, work, or country, is never an easy task. Earlier last year, I decided to take some time off from running for public office to recharge and spend more time in Indiana with my family. However, looking where we are today, I could not abandon our Republic. Last week, I decided to run for re-election to represent the 5th Congressional District. I do not take these decisions lightly, but a lot of my constituents were upset I was not running, as well as a lot of my colleagues, so in these challenging times I needed to give voters a choice of someone who will actually fight for them and conservative policies - not personal agenda. We must carry on the sacrifice of countless Americans for our liberties and keep the American dream alive for our children. I would appreciate your support! Contact [**phil@migop.org**](mailto:phil@migop.org?subject=Election Integrity Information&body=) to get involved. --- --- --- --- Victory in 2024 and beyond begins at the local level—in your communities. Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding. That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, which is now available on DVD. In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit." This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America. The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it. In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [**many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. _**Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.**_ I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

**[Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to personally endorse my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Montana.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=2f6292a2abde4df1b223a70bf6755326&_e=A0Ud3zaB7FAzmNc2v3dUaT89PC5WOicFdYi-7QgEZRefEoDpPbYOCPCmOmtQ2JHJ6uZvC0K3_2kdD2GyGXeS6yPFx-5108LLE9z1bP9y993jo3xw-rAirsyscIHUcPwAsqSG5OtOZf7DbXI3szJUOWKMxY9hY4O9e-rXy-YGQh9446Iqmz7T1loOvDmhvfEoe7OCiUYg1_JV1l1gLPPvY5ly65RkoekBL5EF3W6PT-84lxDS1MguNs4waW5Ouihv94hvlcUnbkd_ne-ORZeXv6RAmZLGoK1GqGcYfiikQ8sEn8swPkEOWQOTWobojTLnhJVr6l2lm-cftmGKV7zbvrjn5CSz2KRvqGLAVxSEACxXDH3M25-jryd4QAg4VFtH1tqtohbNo8pG8c0b9KBFXoK_w0R1xA--PZ8ukXV6uAk%3D)**

_**Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. **_

Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that **anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it.**

**I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read.**

In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis.

Happy (almost) Valentine's Day, friend!
Doughnuts may just be the great love of my life. (If my husband, Robert, is reading this, I'm totally joking... Love you, babe! 💕🍩)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78910013/454858751/1820369458?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk794-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTkzNDYzZjctN2FjYS1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=UKYZ_6VIZ_2YZ_e_xu5lLd76vNGDQwF2NioVYZmZhRE=)
Obviously, doughnuts are great in their own right. They're delicious, dangerously sweet, and the perfect treat to enjoy with a _cafecito_. But doughnuts hold an extra-special significance for me — and this fall, they're going to help us flip Florida blue. Will you let me explain?
**[(If you're short on time and ready to retire Rick Scott next fall, you can chip in here to help me save our Senate majority!)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78910014/454858752/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk794-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTkzNDYzZjctN2FjYS1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=UKYZ_6VIZ_2YZ_e_xu5lLd76vNGDQwF2NioVYZmZhRE=)**
When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and _still_ struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the U.S. Senate.**
**Making doughnuts in the wee hours of the morning gave me an American Dream that I never could have imagined. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**
[**That's why I'm asking you to chip in just $10 — about the cost of a dozen doughnuts — to send me to the Senate. Can you chip in before Valentine's Day ends to help me defeat Rick Scott? This campaign is powered by small-dollar donations, and every single gift makes a difference.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78910015/454858753/1820369458?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk794-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTkzNDYzZjctN2FjYS1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=UKYZ_6VIZ_2YZ_e_xu5lLd76vNGDQwF2NioVYZmZhRE=)

Peter, I’ve heard from so many of you asking about the Special Counsel's report last week. Thank you for your love and support. You probably know the basics: Joe cooperated fully with a Special Counsel’s investigation and they found he did nothing wrong -- no criminal charges were warranted. [**I thought Heather Cox Richardson wrote about it eloquently here.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/mw31GZsW-tYdpIw-ePlYv6bq_QxxjplU1kJ0CoCnLsDkROKYid79RHT9EZgTXxFVV0yd5F1Dz_m4LP8TSwxPOWom0uxsFeivj-mhBiRLQ_Fk1TEbEyi_5OBR6T2djZveSM31eAD17nUzQp4YoLMeFvf-p-iHkiuiNcX3rJd2eOwAUbl_HMByR_9hdDr5olfIpL9Mm-3UrNLIHgwDVzitW5qiUrY8BmIB1K6Dkjs_mcBRt1GGgRkjo3e6qJYlKTy4IyrL1nEAnMW_9NQBUuK1Kzyu-q01dfI3XNKIWfqVLeLaaNBasSTCvxcApyexHha9nOUWt7abmPd8DRP6MB_6n2RYT6YO7cfMNUwgR7X_GPQ/43t/Zgb-bo1LRV2gGuHaDLd6pA/h0/DCDtKptMuK7vR6EsXocxfel1A44lTYP9HXhuIAxnAGM) The reason I’m writing is because of what else was in the report: Inaccurate and personal political attacks about Joe. Rather than just saying the case was closed, as they have for others, the Special Counsel claimed that Joe “couldn’t remember the year his son died.” Believe me, like anyone who has lost a child, Beau and his death never leave him. I hope you can imagine how it felt to read that attack -- not just as Joe’s wife, but as Beau’s mother. I don’t know what this Special Counsel was trying to achieve. We should give everyone grace, and I can’t imagine someone would try to use our son’s death to score political points. If you’ve experienced a loss like that, you know that you don’t measure it in years -- you measure it in grief. May 30th is a day forever etched on our hearts. It shattered me, it shattered our family. So many of you know that feeling after you lose a loved one, where you feel like you can’t get off the floor. What helped me, and what helped Joe, was to find purpose. That’s what keeps Joe going, serving you and the country we love. Joe is 81, that’s true, but he’s 81 doing more in an hour than most people do in a day. Joe has wisdom, empathy, and vision. He has delivered on so many of his promises as President precisely because he’s learned a lot in those 81 years. His age, with his experience and expertise, is an incredible asset and he proves it every day. Look at all he’s accomplished: He brought our country back from COVID. He brought our economy back from the brink. He created 14 million jobs. Gas prices are down. Inflation is down. Energy costs are down. He got bipartisan legislation passed -- even in the midst of this hyper-partisan environment. The media may not give him credit, but I’m thankful you realize all he’s done for this country. Joe is the most resilient person I’ve ever known. When he gets knocked down, he gets back up and gets back to work. That’s what he’s doing. It is just so meaningful to both of us to have you behind us. Your support is what keeps this campaign moving forward. At some point in our lives, we’ll all experience grief or loss. We’ll go through challenging moments and twists and turns. But we find joy together, we persevere together, and ultimately we’ll prevail together. Thank you for being part of our campaign. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

name: Shift WA
subject: A legislative victory in Olympia!
body:
Republicans are celebrating a significant win during the 2024 legislative session. Thanks to the support and advocacy of people like you, we can all breathe a sigh of relief. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62806970:sO2gEiieN:m:1:2610672541:9C07632130402CC22E080CB5D1E1611C:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends,

We have exciting news about a recent development from Olympia that directly impacts families across our state.

State Senate Republicans are celebrating a significant win during the 2024 legislative session. Thanks to the support and advocacy of people like you, we can all breathe a sigh of relief knowing that Senate Bill 5770, the Democrats' attempt to jam through a massive property tax increase - which would also have raised rents - has officially been declared dead for this legislative session.

Olympia Democrats were forced to withdraw the bill after the public learned about their attempt to jack up property taxes up to three times the current rate. Your voices were heard loud and clear, and lawmakers received an overwhelming response from constituents who opposed the bill.

The blowback was so intense that, by the end of last week, a handful of Democrats who initially sponsored the bill rushed to remove their names from it. **The fate of the Democrats ' latest tax hike attempt highlights the critical importance of organizations like Shift WA in keeping the public informed about what truly goes on in Olympia.**

But our work depends on the generous support of people like you. To continue keeping you informed about what's really going on in your own backyard, we need your support. **[Please consider contributing $100, $50, or even $10 to help us in our efforts.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62806971:sO2gEiieN:m:1:2610672541:9C07632130402CC22E080CB5D1E1611C:r)**

Shift WA thinks it's worth celebrating this victory while still closely monitoring the latest legislative deadline - today - to see which bills pass at least one chamber and are still alive. Rest assured, we will continue to keep you informed about the bills - both good and bad - that matter most to you and our state.

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team

Juan

It's a simple fact.

70% of Americans DO NOT want a Biden-Trump rematch.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkjsu6v7u9l3qmd01p492jvhibt3ahtojouulcag_rp22sh2s8i6eo37c3im2pr7cjh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

I was molded in the crucible of the Israel Defense Force.

I fought my way to the Promised Land.

And now I'm working to protect it.

**Friend, my name is Mazi Melesa Pilip & I'm the GOP nominee for the biggest race in America - the NY-03 Special Election.**

At 18, I enlisted in the Israel Defence Force & joined the elite Paratrooper Brigade to defend freedom & Democracy from radical Islamic terrorists.

Following my service in the IDF, I legally immigrated to the US to pursue the American Dream.

_**Now, I 'm running for Congress to protect this great country from the Radical Left.**_

_So what happens now will decide everything._

If we're going to win this all-important race and prevent the Democrats from destroying our slim House Majority, we have to finish this campaign strong.

[**An America-first, business owning, family-loving, ferocious one.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c684692%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6pMwveWDxyHjXwwTio59LQ&sysid=1)

Join the fight with me, and become a part of something much bigger than yourself. It’s not just about winning this Congressional race, it’s about [**_putting Americans first, on our own land and in our homes._**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c684694%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UFnLj7rhiUayl8EALaqVWA&sysid=1)
Let’s show those elite Democrats just what happens when someone gets in the way of our liberties.
Hear us roar.

Uninformed and ill-prepared, Terra Lawson Remer failed to understand the background of the reappointment and **ignored the concerns of her constituents and community leaders.**

As your Supervisor, I'll always stand up against hate. I look forward to earning your support.

Kevin
