Peter, we have a MAJOR problem... The **_[Electronic Registration Information Center (ERIC)](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ab5f65c8c0544547aa7ee3676ea580f8&_e=61e8ijpvOHqImNXW26yiX2bTF9fVK4ywJHBjGGCv2f8FjmvrMddXikkvv0HptFHDVQvg18UllI24ZsY_ASy_W9O6EOGY0Y-eQxupUgGn2nFqygBr33co7rsaztWVFMLzWuv1DRfLTggSh4uSBoKLXRDiQ0Upo6N6ORsKRDrk9igVLCRkFOFygSoqU2Ls3tFTgTgVcjNdR4uko2vdKAHcI1u7qAiyWhNrCVrnbKbgXnrcIiB1iFKxzbxt7bABE5mcr_6sQrnCgkQGGpw4jCPWgA8673CGJDen6m-UwI4gSFl3-vmCYFtlkDHgquKkduqS3kKq8VtrPtubU7LDaNBAbB-W8UyNA2f6dgH1A7cUyUOvlnbqZTL2DvVhwaYuktAd)_** , an organization with a dubious mission, is attempting to expand its influence into new states like Virginia and Hawaii. ERIC is a third-party organization not associated with the government; however, its sole mission is to access sensitive election data to which they should not be given access. They have a long history of questionable practices, including sharing sensitive voter data with third-party organizations not affiliated with the government. Now, they're setting their sights on Virginia and Hawaii, two states known for their unique electoral landscapes. **If ERIC gains a foothold in these states, it could spell disaster for our election system.**

---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ab5f65c8c0544547aa7ee3676ea580f8&_e=61e8ijpvOHqImNXW26yiX2bTF9fVK4ywJHBjGGCv2f8FjmvrMddXikkvv0HptFHDVQvg18UllI24ZsY_ASy_W9O6EOGY0Y-eQxupUgGn2nFqygBr33co7rsaztWVFMLzWuv1DRfLTggSh4uSBoKLXRDiQ0Upo6N6ORsKRDrk9igVLCRkFOFygSoqU2Ls3tFTgTgVcjNdR4uko2vdKAHcI1u7qAiyWhNrCVrnbKbgXnouwH0aVTFjaRLISZAMZx7s-js496QHBSj6Xj8FIMXd7GneLk7mpydtWWzvXVmZ5j4gRMBEvGB8qw-jDIAWh06LuU9sSzA-H6zv_f7coG0MmdYwac-_jNqCipWYtQQEJBXot7ojr2vA-9IvzFbCt2JG)

We cannot allow this to happen. As advocates for fair and transparent elections, we must take a stand against the expansion of ERIC. We must ensure any voter registration initiatives are conducted with the utmost transparency and accountability - not by a third-party organization in a backroom. Voter Reference Foundation is putting the power back in the hands of The People and taking it away from liberals using vehicles like ERIC fund projects in the shadows. **Help fund our fight 👉** _**[https://voter-reference-foundation.revv.co/action-eric-expansion/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ab5f65c8c0544547aa7ee3676ea580f8&_e=61e8ijpvOHqImNXW26yiX2bTF9fVK4ywJHBjGGCv2f8FjmvrMddXikkvv0HptFHDVQvg18UllI24ZsY_ASy_W9O6EOGY0Y-eQxupUgGn2nFqygBr33co7rsaztWVFMLzWuv1DRfLTggSh4uSBoKLXRDiQ0Upo6N6ORsKRDrk9igVLCRkFOFygSoqU2Ls3tFTgTgVcjNdR4uko2vdKAHcI1u7qAiyWhNrCVrnbKbgXnozWFnjWRjFD16s_YN7EseDFYxw1oWoZbGO_NrvXdgwCCUSjjXxnpTC0QSaelwztuIwpnTVV0HUfg7UrsMWqRCz5fe0FVZWYXmI-OcFRaV9BtMka_lTfYNbMSeAa9A1cxHlgbu0GGnYWlHxWFaGQ8Al)**_ **Our national laws make it clear: oversight of voter lists belongs to the public. However, barriers like process complications and data access costs make it harder for the public to access.** We're breaking these barriers by purchasing, sorting, and publishing voter data nationwide. name: Tina Forsberg
subject: Only 3 weeks!
body:
Peter

The sand in the hourglass is falling more quickly these days in the campaign. We only have three weeks left until Election Day.

_Election Day is March 5 th. Early Voting Begins February 15 through March 2nd_.

We need our friends. We need our A-Team to close out this campaign.

**First, please consider a contribution TODAY. $500, $250, $100, $50, $35 or whatever you can afford will go a long way to help us finish the remaining television, radio, and mail advertising we have left**.

[****](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)

Second, we need volunteers to help us greet at the polls during Early Voting. The Castelli campaign is leaving no stone unturned. We are going to have people at every early voting location across the district. Please contact the campaign or sign up using the links below.
[Cabarrus](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0B4CA4AA2CAAFCC25-47098254-cabarrus)
[Davidson](https://www.signupgenius.com/tabs/13570DE0EA3CCE4C7AC5-earlypoll)
[Davie](https://www.signupgenius.com/tabs/13570DE0EA3CCE4C7AC5-castelli3)
[Forsyth](https://www.signupgenius.com/tabs/13570DE0EA3CCE4C7AC5-castelli)
[Guilford](https://www.signupgenius.com/tabs/13570DE0EA3CCE4C7AC5-castelli1)
[Rowan](https://www.signupgenius.com/tabs/13570DE0EA3CCE4C7AC5-castelli2)

And finally, we are scheduling call nights during the week for volunteers to come into the office or make calls from home into neighborhoods across the district encouraging people to get out and vote for Christian Castelli. Reply back to this email for details and to RSVP.
* Christian Castelli is the right man with the right skills and experience at the right time to represent us in Congress.
* Christian is an America First Patriot and decorated combat Green Beret.
* Christian Castelli is the most experienced candidate in this race.
* Christian possesses a global, federal, state, and local perspective on the issues facing America.
* Christian is a conservative who will make us proud.

**Perhaps you cannot volunteer. Please consider a contribution TODAY of $500, $250, $100, $50, $35 or whatever you can to help. Let 's send a conservative Green Beret to Congress.**

[****](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)****

This election is too important to send the wrong person to Congress. Sending a career politician or lobbyist is the wrong decision.

_Let 's send a conservative Green Beret to take The Hill. Christian will secure our border, eliminate wasteful spending, inflation, and project American strength abroad. _

In case you missed it, Christian gave an interview on Charlotte's WBT Bo and Beth Show this morning's drive time show.

[Listen here.](https://youtu.be/Ym-3w6fu3tA)

Tina Forsberg
Campaign Manager
Castelli for Congress

| Let me tell you about my pre-existing condition:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2007%2E35263%2EiY6D3X)
Hi Peter, can I share something with you? When I was young, I was diagnosed with a serious illness that resulted in three months in the hospital. When I recovered, my grandparents, who raised me, searched for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. They wanted to make sure I was protected in case I got sick again. Unfortunately, they couldn't find a policy that would cover me because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. All because I had a _"pre-existing condition."_ My grandparents had to pay for my health care out of pocket, and they had to make significant sacrifices to do so. I saw my grandparents worry about me and how they would pay for my care. **I got into public service because I believed no one should have to go through this.** My story isn't a unique one — it's an experience shared by 133 million Americans living with pre-existing conditions. Before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, people with pre-existing conditions could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed that health care reform, and fought to pass my legislation allowing young people to stay on their parents' insurance plan until they turn 26. These changes have helped millions of Americans get the health insurance they need. But now, Republicans are attacking our health care and threatening the protections for people with pre-existing conditions. If Mitch McConnell and Republicans flip the Senate, they could roll back on our progress and take our country back to a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. I fought against Republican efforts to repeal the _Affordable Care Act_ before, and I will continue to defend it. **But I can't do it alone, Peter. I need your help to keep up this fight in the U.S. Senate.** **[Will you make a donation to my reelection campaign so I can keep up this critical work? I need your help to defend our Senate majority and prevent Republicans from rolling back the progress we've made expanding access to affordable health care.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3587?c0=tbe-em-feb24.Kl22mX&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20240213_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2007%2E35263%2EiY6D3X)** _Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue._ | | [CHIP IN $5 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3604?c0=tbe-em-feb24.MPANP7&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20240213_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=2007%2E35263%2EiY6D3X)

subject: Hurting the working class. Harming the environment.
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQdxs6dmtfaKNzbQRIbUHTZ4BwdGKIjEEvbwmfS5A7w-waknuHJrmNcFMB8154KJRuA&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=021324_jim_justice&n=1)
---
Dear Friend, My likely opponent in November will be Jim Justice, the current Governor of West Virginia, whom Trump affectionately calls Big Jim and who is also one of the wealthiest men in West Virginia. Big Jim made his fortune through unethical business practices, by destroying the environment, and causing harm to his own employees:
* He has been sued more than 600 times for not paying his workers, vendors, business partners, and government agencies.
* At one point, he was dubbed the nation's "top mine safety delinquent."
* He stopped paying premiums for his retired miners' health insurance.
* He has $300 million in longstanding unpaid business loans.

But the worst thing is not what he did as a private citizen but what he did and didn't do as an elected official. During his seven years as a Governor, he has failed to ease up the opioid crisis, address teacher shortages, protect university programs from cuts, and fix the unsafe conditions and growing violence in the correctional system. **He signed into law legislation prohibiting gender-affirming care for minors and the abortion ban and created felony penalties for protests targeting oil and gas facilities.** His record as a Governor, his ties to Trump, and his disregard for environmental and labor standards give us a glimpse into his future work as a Senator. While Jim Justice has his moneyed interests, working-class West Virginian voters have our campaign’s back. And we know that organized people outperform organized money every time. Our average campaign donation is $33.99. **[Will you rush in $33.99 to ensure our organizers get paid and we have funds for transportation and plenty of campaign material to distribute?](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQdxs6dmtfaKNzbQRIbUHTZ4BwdGKIjEEvbwmfS5A7w-waknuHJrmNcFMB8154KJRuA&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=021324_jim_justice&n=2)** Many political donors are abandoning people in West Virginia as if this small working-class state didn’t matter. **But our state counts for as many votes in the Senate as California, New York, or Texas. And our Senators can do as much harm or good as those from bigger states.** I appreciate that you recognize this and support our campaign to bring progress to West Virginians and all Americans. **[If you can sign up for even the smallest monthly donation today, you can make a big difference in our race.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQdxs6dmtfaKNzbQRIbUHTZ4V8N60AdpwGw9aoipESTEo3lH6AOvilBjvd6r55aJvsg&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=021324_jim_justice&n=3)** In Solidarity, Zach Shrewsbury (D-W) Candidate, U.S. Senate

subject: These comments could put Jamaal Bowman’s safety at risk
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

When Westchester County Executive and Rep. Jamaal Bowman’s moderate
primary opponent George Latimer was asked about taking $600,000 from
anti-Palestinian lobby group AIPAC at a Black History Month event last
Saturday, he lashed out and made racist, Islamophobic comments attacking
Jamaal.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240213-jb.F7TUvS&refcode=em20240213-33310&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=33310%2E1203867%2EaEgJSx ]One New Rochelle voter stated, “But you are taking money from the
devil.” Mr. Latimer responded, “Bowman is taking money from the devil too,
he’s taking money from Hamas.”
Source: Black Westchester

This isn’t just an obscene, ugly lie — it’s the kind of dangerous rhetoric
that stokes anti-Muslim hate crimes and could put Jamaal’s safety at risk.

Black Westchester reports, “When asked for proof to back up his statement,
Latimer pulled out his phone to show her an article he couldn’t find, took
her email, and promised to email the female voter the proof. When she
asked that he didn’t forget to send the email, he replied to her, “You
probably won’t read it or believe it anyway,” as he walked away.”

It’s shameful that Latimer resorted to spreading disinformation about his
opponent when confronted about the fact that 40% of his campaign’s
fundraising is from the GOP-funded, corporate-backed lobby group who
hand-selected him to run against Jamaal in an attempt to stifle our
progressive movement.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240213-jb.F7TUvS&refcode=em20240213-33310&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=33310%2E1203867%2EaEgJSx ]Will you help us defend Jamaal from these disgusting attacks and
re-elect him to the U.S. House by splitting a grassroots contribution to
his campaign and Justice Democrats now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240213-jb.F7TUvS&refcode=em20240213-33310&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=33310%2E1203867%2EaEgJSx ]Contribute $3

In June, voters in New York’s 16th district will choose between an AIPAC
shill or a progressive incumbent standing on the right side of history.
Let’s do everything in our power now to defend Jamaal’s seat and keep a
real leader for the people in Congress.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)

Fellow Americans,

Sometimes, it’s easy to get lost in hysteria. It’s easy to assume that people speak in overstatements.

**But, when a special counsel appointed by his own Department of Justice describes the sitting President as _‘An Elderly Man with a Poor Memory,’_ you should know that this is no longer a Left versus Right disagreement.**

| | | I grew up in an Ethiopian village with no running water.

Because I was a Jew living under an oppressive dictatorship- I was evacuated to Israel with the help of the United States.

At 18 years old I enlisted in the Israeli Defense Forces to defend the values & blessings of freedom from radical Islamic terrorists.

Today I'm a loving mother of 7 beautiful children & the GOP nominee in the NY-03 Special Election.

The Special Election was declared just weeks ago & I launched my campaign immediately- but the liberal Governor of New York didn't want to give us any time to build momentum & mount a serious challenge.

And now Election Day is finally here.

But I've started from scratch before & I'm no stranger to being an underdog.

It is not secret- this race is going to be won or lost at the grassroots level.

And the support this email generates will quite literally decide whether we keep this seat red- or whether Joe Biden walks away with another win.

I was born under the Ethiopian sun.

I was molded in the crucible of the Israel Defense Force.

I fought my way to the Promised Land.

And now I'm working to protect it.

**Friend, my name is Mazi Melesa Pilip & I'm the GOP nominee for the biggest race in America - the NY-03 Special Election.**

If you don't know me already, let me tell you a little about myself:

I'm an Ethiopian-born Jew who fled to Israel at the age of 12 to escape Jewish persecution.

At 18, I enlisted in the Israel Defence Force & joined the elite Paratrooper Brigade to defend freedom & Democracy from radical Islamic terrorists.

Following my service in the IDF, I legally immigrated to the US to pursue the American Dream.

_**Now, I 'm running for Congress to protect this great country from the Radical Left.**_

_So what happens now will decide everything._

| | Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPmzAQhX-NuRnZY4PhwKEsIZWqplJaqeoJDXjYuMKBNaZo--sronSv33vz5j30y-TG94qZmgHcnF0ZAFOfGMDbr92H7bf_cua1EIq_5RefHSq8MID4vtCH9ZmSkkc3HdQ0ia3UaIVOqJJGmEJnuSmTW9VTL8aBQJYGDRkqCiyLYpSl7hFQy8RVIEALkEoapaBMsSgzQVpST6aXmDMtHn9S9BTcgHKNO4Ywzz4dZp9M1S3GZX0Uaxm0Kw1boBTvZOd4OBi0Fv84y29zmHcX__IxENnZ84HukcKhWyWsQcmhhIzr0SIvx2zkmKEchS6LLBNMtVv03TpvYSCmmro58-vpwiA_sCfrNs9Uc_r6JAP6Bd3rnanm_8Cubs5d87l96b7VJ-iup0v3_Qf_eX1eRApHwh5kEiq77G6a3JobpsXrY_8w-38BAAD__xCYiFY)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPmzAQhX-NuRnZY4PhwKEsIZWqplJaqeoJDXjYuMKBNaZo--sronSv33vz5j30y-TG94qZmgHcnF0ZAFOfGMDbr92H7bf_cua1EIq_5RefHSq8MID4vtCH9ZmSkkc3HdQ0ia3UaIVOqJJGmEJnuSmTW9VTL8aBQJYGDRkqCiyLYpSl7hFQy8RVIEALkEoapaBMsSgzQVpST6aXmDMtHn9S9BTcgHKNO4Ywzz4dZp9M1S3GZX0Uaxm0Kw1boBTvZOd4OBi0Fv84y29zmHcX__IxENnZ84HukcKhWyWsQcmhhIzr0SIvx2zkmKEchS6LLBNMtVv03TpvYSCmmro58-vpwiA_sCfrNs9Uc_r6JAP6Bd3rnanm_8Cubs5d87l96b7VJ-iup0v3_Qf_eX1eRApHwh5kEiq77G6a3JobpsXrY_8w-38BAAD__xCYiFY)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

Provides that a person who is prohibited from possessing a firearm because such person is subject to a protective order or has been convicted of an assault and battery of a family or household member may transfer a firearm owned by such prohibited person to any person who is not otherwise prohibited by law from possessing such firearm, provided that such person who is not otherwise prohibited by law from possessing such firearm is 21 years of age or older and does not reside with the person who is subject to the protective order. Under current law, there is no requirement that such transferee cannot be younger than 21 years of age and cannot reside with such prohibited person. The bill also provides that such prohibited person who transfers, sells, or surrenders a firearm pursuant to the provisions of the bill shall inform the clerk of the court of the name and address of the transferee, the federally licensed firearms dealer, or the law-enforcement agency in possession of the firearm and shall provide a copy of such form to the transferee. The bill also provides that a person who is prohibited from possessing a firearm because such person is subject to a protective order or has been convicted of an assault and battery of a family or household member shall be advised that a law-enforcement officer may obtain a search warrant to search for any firearms from such person if such law-enforcement officer has reason to believe that such person has not relinquished all firearms in his possession. body:
Two weeks ago I traveled to Las Vegas, NV for the RNCS hosted by Turning Point Action and the Republican National Committee's Winter Meeting, see this email for my full report.
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ylEY5Mg8uy2VAaP2UBGxEk258XhiBW0-Q42mjcm-OzH25ibOyrAdQ173U0l0OWxFX7GwKuO1VRgqDcS57DvpNH8zSNf4QbYaipExL1LolnTYhY2XtMMKqpA6XUmRgaRJgAEkNF69RcnFe42ZdxDq9cKXlzHFRia3&c=O08VopP4ZAJ4faKtMqSUPZNZLKI5FCM6IgBkIlCmyQNizAVvYIqLXw==&ch=owdzwf3s6FmgW0lsATpy0TGK-H03Vxtc3UYxTdsvkCeQ6EnL87jW9A==)

| Friend, A lot happened not only at the RNCS and RNC Winter meeting but a lot has happened the last two weeks! The US Supreme Court is deciding whether or not they will allow a slim minority to disenfranchise the majority in the 2024 Elections.
Then in the midst of this, last week, Nikki Haley lost to "None of these candidates" in the NV GOP Primary election, followed by President Trump's massive success at the NV GOP Caucus on Thursday. The same day that President Biden was declared Senile by his very own DOJ.
At the end of January, as you know I traveled to Las Vegas at the invitation of Turning Point Action for the Restoring National Confidence Summit and the Republican National Committee's Winter Meeting at the invitation of Colorado's Republican National Committeeman, our friend and ally of the grassroots, Randy B. Corporon.
We started off the week at the Restoring National Confidence Summit hosted by Turning Point Action where we heard from Mike Lindell, Donald Trump Jr, Jack Posobiec, Charlie Kirk, Republican National Committeeman from AZ Tyler Bowyer, and Scott Presler.
Attending this event were Never Ronna/America First Members of the Republican National Committee, the County GOP Chairs of the target counties needed to win the swing states in 2024, and even precinct leaders who are top performers in their states.
The two-day summit was focused intensely on training and equipping the grassroots with the tools necessary to win elections going forward and the information provided was tremendously helpful to us all!
All members of the Republican National Committee were invited to attend including Chairwoman McDaniel and Committeewoman for Colorado, Vera Ortegon, yet neither of them showed up to give the grassroots the time of day.
However, Randy Corporon, Dave Williams, and I all did! We were there every day from 8 am-6 pm listening, engaging, and participating as much as we could, to be better equipped to save our great state.
Photos below are from the RNCS and RNC Winter Meeting with Current Never Ronna Members of the RNC:

| Next up was the Republican National Committee's Winter Meeting. The meeting was very informative and I attended as many of the committee meetings as I could, to better understand the role of the Republican National Committeewoman.
It troubles me greatly that I must say that we have been tremendously underserved by our current representation over the past 8 years...
However, I have to give credit when credit is due, as Vera was very helpful to me at the meeting. As some of you may know, I suffer from a physical handicap. It means I will require ADA assistance when traveling to the RNC convention in Milwaukee this year. Vera sits on the Committee on Arrangements (CoA) and was kind enough to help answer my specific questions and concerns in this regard.
Nonetheless, she was otherwise absent during the week's events. And as noted earlier did not attend the TPA Restoring National Confidence Summit.
She is most interested and connected to the closed-door committee meetings where she has favor with Ronna McDaniel and other establishment politicians. I saw little of her in the meetings that were open to all guests, or in the common areas where we would gather and fellowship.
In this manner, she seems unapproachable. She is happy to continue with the status quo and is uninterested in change. The role of the RNC Committeewoman could be utilized in a better manner.
With engagement, conversations, friendship, and trust being built in rooms outside your comfort zone. I was in both as much as I could be as a guest. Together, with your help, we can make this position all that it can be and more!
The meeting was not without drama, to say the least. You could tell that Ronna McDaniel is frustrated by the pushback she has been receiving following her contentious re-election last January. The chairwoman has stacked the committees with her most devout supporters like any good leader would, but instead of making her look strong, it made her look weak.
At the beginning of every committee meeting and even the General Session at the end of the week, there was a 5-10 minute monologue from her and her supporters about how great she is, that she can do no wrong, and that we must stop hating on her as chairwoman. If we don't hell fire and brimstone shall doom us all! If you listen to her cronies...
Then just two weeks later it is reported and confirmed that she will be stepping down following the South Carolina Primary at the request of President Trump... It seems he has even had enough of her failed leadership.
My friends, the time is now, we must send a strong America First Grassroots fighter, with the knowledge and experience necessary for this position to the Republican National Committee.
We must have a representative who votes in line with their constituents. The consultant Uni-Party class has run the National Committee for far too long and it is time to make a change, and it starts with Colorado's National Committeewoman.
---
| I hope you have appreciated my candid report on the RNC Winter Meeting and have appreciated the info on the RNCS with Turning Point Action.
I am asking you to become a delegate and cast your vote for me to be Colorado's next Republican National Committeewoman on April 6th in Pueblo, CO at the State Convention.
Together we will Make the RNC Great Again!
Best,

clean_body: Two weeks ago I traveled to Las Vegas, NV for the RNCS hosted by Turning Point Action and the Republican National Committee's Winter Meeting, see this email for my full report. | | | | == | Friend, A lot happened not only at the RNCS and RNC Winter meeting but a lot has happened the last two weeks! The US Supreme Court is deciding whether or not they will allow a slim minority to disenfranchise the majority in the 2024 Elections. Then in the midst of this, last week, Nikki Haley lost to "None of these candidates" in the NV GOP Primary election, followed by President Trump's massive success at the NV GOP Caucus on Thursday. The same day that President Biden was declared Senile by his very own DOJ. At the end of January, as you know I traveled to Las Vegas at the invitation of Turning Point Action for the Restoring National Confidence Summit and the Republican National Committee's Winter Meeting at the invitation of Colorado's Republican National Committeeman, our friend and ally of the grassroots, Randy B. Corporon. We started off the week at the Restoring National Confidence Summit hosted by Turning Point Action where we heard from Mike Lindell, Donald Trump Jr, Jack Posobiec, Charlie Kirk, Republican National Committeeman from AZ Tyler Bowyer, and Scott Presler. Attending this event were Never Ronna/America First Members of the Republican National Committee, the County GOP Chairs of the target counties needed to win the swing states in 2024, and even precinct leaders who are top performers in their states. The two-day summit was focused intensely on training and equipping the grassroots with the tools necessary to win elections going forward and the information provided was tremendously helpful to us all! All members of the Republican National Committee were invited to attend including Chairwoman McDaniel and Committeewoman for Colorado, Vera Ortegon, yet neither of them showed up to give the grassroots the time of day. However, Randy Corporon, Dave Williams, and I all did! We were there every day from 8 am-6 pm listening, engaging, and participating as much as we could, to be better equipped to save our great state. Photos below are from the RNCS and RNC Winter Meeting with Current Never Ronna Members of the RNC: | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Next up was the Republican National Committee's Winter Meeting. The meeting was very informative and I attended as many of the committee meetings as I could, to better understand the role of the Republican National Committeewoman. It troubles me greatly that I must say that we have been tremendously underserved by our current representation over the past 8 years... However, I have to give credit when credit is due, as Vera was very helpful to me at the meeting. As some of you may know, I suffer from a physical handicap. It means I will require ADA assistance when traveling to the RNC convention in Milwaukee this year. Vera sits on the Committee on Arrangements (CoA) and was kind enough to help answer my specific questions and concerns in this regard. Nonetheless, she was otherwise absent during the week's events. And as noted earlier did not attend the TPA Restoring National Confidence Summit. She is most interested and connected to the closed-door committee meetings where she has favor with Ronna McDaniel and other establishment politicians. I saw little of her in the meetings that were open to all guests, or in the common areas where we would gather and fellowship. In this manner, she seems unapproachable. She is happy to continue with the status quo and is uninterested in change. The role of the RNC Committeewoman could be utilized in a better manner. With engagement, conversations, friendship, and trust being built in rooms outside your comfort zone. I was in both as much as I could be as a guest. Together, with your help, we can make this position all that it can be and more! The meeting was not without drama, to say the least. You could tell that Ronna McDaniel is frustrated by the pushback she has been receiving following her contentious re-election last January. The chairwoman has stacked the committees with her most devout supporters like any good leader would, but instead of making her look strong, it made her look weak. At the beginning of every committee meeting and even the General Session at the end of the week, there was a 5-10 minute monologue from her and her supporters about how great she is, that she can do no wrong, and that we must stop hating on her as chairwoman. If we don't hell fire and brimstone shall doom us all! If you listen to her cronies... Then just two weeks later it is reported and confirmed that she will be stepping down following the South Carolina Primary at the request of President Trump... It seems he has even had enough of her failed leadership. My friends, the time is now, we must send a strong America First Grassroots fighter, with the knowledge and experience necessary for this position to the Republican National Committee. We must have a representative who votes in line with their constituents. The consultant Uni-Party class has run the National Committee for far too long and it is time to make a change, and it starts with Colorado's National Committeewoman. | I hope you have appreciated my candid report on the RNC Winter Meeting and have appreciated the info on the RNCS with Turning Point Action. I am asking you to become a delegate and cast your vote for me to be Colorado's next Republican National Committeewoman on April 6th in Pueblo, CO at the State Convention. Together we will Make the RNC Great Again! My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

The numbers don’t lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.

---
1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign “connecting the dots” between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.

body:
As many of you know, I’m a sportsman. I’m happiest when... | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/4ea3d547b6bf/saturday-plans-6691950?e=5456f2ac8b)
---

Friends –
As many of you know, I’m a sportsman. I’m happiest hiking the Cascade Mountains, fly fishing onWashington’s rivers or clam digging at the beach. This State is blessed with wonderful natural resources and I believe it’s absolutely critical that we care for the land in a way the ensures our future generations get to enjoy it as much as I do!
That’s why I was thrilled when my friend Jaime Herrera Beutler announced her campaign for Commissioner of Public Lands. Her skillset and her interests are so well suited for this role, I can’t think of a better candidate to put forth.
[Will you join me in making a donation to Jaime’s campaign today?](https://jaimeforlands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f880cdc0c3e720dcafaf72d5&id=88dd230dc9&e=5456f2ac8b)
For those of you who don’t know, the Public Lands Commissioner runs the Department of Natural Resources (DNR). All told, DNR sets policy for almost 40% of our state – whether it’s the 3 million acres in the state's land trust, the 2.6 million acres of beaches, tidelands lake and rivers, or the 12 million acres of public and private lands.
Jaime spent a dozen years in Congress and while there, she scored some big victories to improve the way our forests are run and provide resources to fight wild land fires. But there’s a lot more to be done, and frankly, the work must be done right here at home. In fact, her main priority is to help end the cycle of annual forest fires and smoke that has choked our region over the last several summers.
I know from experience, that a Statewide campaign is expensive and down ballot races don’t get the attention others do but are just as critical to the future of our state. That’s why I’m asking all my friends to support her race with a donation. We know she’s going to need about $2 million dollars to reach voters across the State.
When I ran statewide, Jaime was there to help. Politics is a team sport and Jaime is a teammate I’m thrilled to help out. We need her on our Statewide Republican Team. A recent poll shows Jaime leading all seven candidates in this race, regardless of party. I’d like to help make sure she has the resources to get her winning message out across all of Washington so please, [make a donation to her campaign today!](https://jaimeforlands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f880cdc0c3e720dcafaf72d5&id=fad49599d2&e=5456f2ac8b)
Thank you!
Reagan Dunn
P.S. I forgot to mention –contributions to Jaime’s campaign are limited to $4,800 per person and business. [I hope you’ll be as generous as you’re able!](https://jaimeforlands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f880cdc0c3e720dcafaf72d5&id=c3243b60f7&e=5456f2ac8b) Thank you so much!

---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California.• Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don’t lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---

The war, which began in 2014 and escalated with Russia’s invasion in 2022, is currently at a stalemate despite more than $113 billion in U.S. funding and additional aid to Ukraine from its European neighbors. ### [** _The Return of the Zombie Banks_**](https://ssspl.mjt.lu/lnk/AWoAADhKlcwAAc4BO7AAA5vbC1wAAYDOz7cAnf7RACZcGQBly74nWiWsiunETL2V8itqJOhxSQAjuaE/5/Judy27GvCvx3m5_ay-gpKQ/aHR0cHM6Ly90aGVwcmlja2x5cGVhci5vcmcvdGhlLXJldHVybi1vZi10aGUtem9tYmllLWJhbmtzLz91dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249V2hhdCUyMFN1cnByaXNlZCUyMFR1Y2tlciUyMENhcmxzb24lMjBNb3N0JTIwQWJvdXQlMjBIaXMlMjBQdXRpbiUyMEludGVydmlldyUyMCgzKSZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9bWFpbGpldA)
In a case of life imitating fiction, we have the case of Signature Bank and New York Community Bank (“NYCB”). Signature Bank turned into a zombie bank by becoming seriously insolvent. Predictably, the FDIC and the Federal Reserve rode to the rescue on their white horses and protected the depositors (including those whose deposits exceeded the $250,000 FDIC limit) by arranging for Signature Bank to be acquired by NYCB.

Unfortunately for NYCB, the zombie virus that infected Signature Bank has proven to be contagious, with the result that NYCB may be on its way to becoming a zombie bank itself. The stock of its parent, New York Community Bancorp, Inc., dropped like a safe falling out of a seventeen-story building in the last couple of weeks from about $11 down to as far as $3.60. The drop in stock price was so abrupt that the New York Stock Exchange circuit-breakers for that issue were triggered. Bad loans and higher reserve requirements appear to be the major culprits.
### [**_When Stalin Came to Casa Grande (Part 1)_**](https://ssspl.mjt.lu/lnk/AWoAADhKlcwAAc4BO7AAA5vbC1wAAYDOz7cAnf7RACZcGQBly74nWiWsiunETL2V8itqJOhxSQAjuaE/6/IjT_)
Franklin Roosevelt’s New Deal created the largest agricultural collective in the US as an experiment to test socialist theories about both farming and human nature. Collectives have a long history in the US and elsewhere, and they all failed. In the Soviet model, this failure was admitted, and thus the collectivization required force, terror, and starvation to “convince” people to operate properly in the collective environment. But even with massive brutal force and the full weight of the state, in the end, they could not make the idea work. Most food production came from a small amount of privately owned plots that represented about 3% of the land under cultivation.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral]
Hi Friend,
I hope your February is going well and wanted to share some updates on how I have been hard at work since taking office!
I am honored to have been named the Chair of City Council's Committee on Public Health and Hu man Services . I look forward to using my passion and expertise to hit the ground running and get to work making Philadelphia a healthier city with a stronger future! I am equally thrilled to be serving as Vice Chair of City Council's Committee on Global Opportunities and the Creative/Innovative Economy as well as a member of the Committees on Education , Environment , Ethics , Finance , Streets & Services , Labor & Civil Service , Fiscal Stability & Intergovernmental Cooperation , and the Whole Council .
I have big plans in the works and I have already had the privilege of introducing Resolutions Recognizing January 2024 as Human Trafficking Prevention Month in Philadelphia and honoring Professor Dr. Bernard P. Anderson on the occasion of Black History Month . Please stay tuned and in touch to see everything that I'm working on for Philadelphia!
I have also been busy supporting our wonderful Democratic allies up and down the ballot this cycle. I hope that you are staying engaged during this election as there is so much at stake in Pennsylvania and across the United States in 2024 !
As always, I am endlessly optimistic for Philadelphia and deeply grateful for your support. I carry you with me each and every day.
I look forward to hearing more from you and ask for your continued partnership in the hard work of improving the lives of every Philadelphian. I know that we can do this together!
Thank you again,
Councilmember Nina Ahmad

name: Ro Khanna
subject: 7 million affordable homes
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

America has an affordable housing problem.

The Joint Center for Housing Studies of Harvard University found that a record half of renters [https://www.npr.org/2024/01/25/1225957874/housing-unaffordable-for-record-half-all-u-s-renters-study-finds] are now spending more than 30 percent of their income on housing. Although millions of Americans qualify for federal housing subsidies, the lack of funding for the Housing Trust Fund makes meeting the need for affordable housing next to impossible. On top of that, Wall Street is buying up single-family residential homes nationwide, making it harder for families and individuals to buy homes.

We can’t go on like this. Sign if you agree: Housing is a human right. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/affordable-housing-petition?contactdata=7EjgjrhNQspvXuVYNmT/t5MCAkwZb1HHfCverrVNDeYiz29G0tyfS5hDlIRQ0tAudoq4r+Hu0Hs3+JUmgoa9eNAIjJq7hxvgwwuDhYzVRLWr3nyJxLrQ5OKi5d1JZneihS194sYUruKYH+FmNhIZKQ==]

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1750667884492149134?s=20 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1750667884492149134?s=20]

Congress must take steps to address the housing crisis. A $445 billion investment in the Housing Trust Fund would allow states to construct over 7 million affordable homes. Additionally, by passing my Stop Wall Street Landlords Act, we can ban private equity firms from obtaining loans backed by the Federal Housing Finance Agency for the purchase of single-family residential homes.

Every American deserves the ability to keep a roof over their head. If we want a strong economy, we need to make housing affordable and give people a chance to build wealth through homeownership. That means investing in the Housing Trust Fund to build millions of affordable homes and putting an end to Wall Street’s real estate grab.

Sign the petition: Tell Congress to invest in affordable housing. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/affordable-housing-petition?contactdata=7EjgjrhNQspvXuVYNmT/t5MCAkwZb1HHfCverrVNDeYiz29G0tyfS5hDlIRQ0tAudoq4r+Hu0Hs3+JUmgoa9eNAIjJq7hxvgwwuDhYzVRLWr3nyJxLrQ5OKi5d1JZneihS194sYUruKYH+FmNhIZKQ==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

body:
Send a Veteran to Congress |
---
| | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=fb95250870&e=1090c5c412)
---
|
---
| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

The big news today is Senate passage of a $95 billion foreign aid package. I read all 82 pages of the bill last evening. As written, I would oppose this legislation in the House.

The bill has some positive provisions. It replenishes stocks of American weapons that have been sent to Ukraine and Israel. It provides advanced air defenses to protect critical infrastructure and civilians. And it would help Taiwan defend itself against Chinese aggression. Taiwan is important to the U.S. because it produces the world’s most advanced semiconductor chips used in weapons, consumer electronics and computing devices. We can’t let that capability fall under Chinese control.

But the bill also provides billions of dollars in cash to the Ukrainian government without adequate oversight. It fails to establish clear objectives or an endgame for Ukrainian aid. And it includes hundreds of millions of dollars for “refugee and entrant assistance” to help illegal immigrants come to the United States. Yes, that’s actually in the bill.

When I speak with people across Pennsylvania’s 7th Congressional District, the number one national security issue they ask me about is our porous border. House Republicans have demanded that any supplemental national security bill must include strong provisions to secure the border. I agree, and so do most Americans. We still have time to get this right.

Susan Wild and President Biden have opened our borders, weakened our military, and emboldened our enemies around the world. The only way to keep us safe at home and out of wars abroad is to secure our borders and deter our adversaries with a fearsome military. That’s what “peace through strength” is all about.

In Congress, I’ll apply my 28 years of experience in the Army and the Air Force to rebuild our military and reestablish our national deterrence. I’ll also use my decades of knowledge in homeland defense to secure our porous border. And I'll apply a simple test to determine whether I would support American military intervention overseas. If it’s worth sending my own son, a soldier, into harm’s way, I will vote yes. Otherwise, I won’t send your son or daughter either.

We are in dangerous times. Send a veteran to Congress.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. clean_body: Send a Veteran to Congress | | | | | Dear Friends and Neighbors, The big news today is Senate passage of a $95 billion foreign aid package. I read all 82 pages of the bill last evening. As written, I would oppose this legislation in the House. The bill has some positive provisions. It replenishes stocks of American weapons that have been sent to Ukraine and Israel. It provides advanced air defenses to protect critical infrastructure and civilians. And it would help Taiwan defend itself against Chinese aggression. Taiwan is important to the U.S. because it produces the world’s most advanced semiconductor chips used in weapons, consumer electronics and computing devices. We can’t let that capability fall under Chinese control. But the bill also provides billions of dollars in cash to the Ukrainian government without adequate oversight. It fails to establish clear objectives or an endgame for Ukrainian aid. And it includes hundreds of millions of dollars for “refugee and entrant assistance” to help illegal immigrants come to the United States. Yes, that’s actually in the bill. When I speak with people across Pennsylvania’s 7th Congressional District, the number one national security issue they ask me about is our porous border. House Republicans have demanded that any supplemental national security bill must include strong provisions to secure the border. I agree, and so do most Americans. We still have time to get this right. Susan Wild and President Biden have opened our borders, weakened our military, and emboldened our enemies around the world. The only way to keep us safe at home and out of wars abroad is to secure our borders and deter our adversaries with a fearsome military. That’s what “peace through strength” is all about. In Congress, I’ll apply my 28 years of experience in the Army and the Air Force to rebuild our military and reestablish our national deterrence. I’ll also use my decades of knowledge in homeland defense to secure our porous border. And I'll apply a simple test to determine whether I would support American military intervention overseas. If it’s worth sending my own son, a soldier, into harm’s way, I will vote yes. Otherwise, I won’t send your son or daughter either. We are in dangerous times. Send a veteran to Congress. Keep America Free. Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. Hello friends!
We hope this edition of the New Pennsylvania Project eBlast finds you well. Please take a few moments to check out all the important news you can use, upcoming events, and other resources as we head towards the April primary and November general elections. Additionally, we hope you’ve been enjoying our Black History Month celebrations taking part across all our social media platforms!
|
---
# Why Courts Matter
As the noise of the 2024 election cycle continues to take up a ton of space, NPP is making a commitment to ensuring important conversations around courts and judges doesn’t stop during this even year election. With that said, we’ll be partnering with Why Courts Matter-PA —a non-partisan advocacy campaign seeking to protect the independence of our state and federal courts, and educate the electorate about their importance — to bring “Courts Corner” to each NPP eBlast in 2024. #CourtsMatter
In future eBlasts, you’ll find all the important courts news and information in it’s own dedicated section but for today, please take some time to check out the following links:
[Republicans sue Gov. Shapiro over automatic voter registration](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6ccdf4315c&e=95417d7e87)(Armchair Lehigh Valley)
* Republican state lawmakers who are part of the Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus are challenging Gov. Josh Shapiro’s automatic voter registration policy, claiming in a federal lawsuit that the Democrat infringed on their civil rights to make election law.

[Pennsylvania high court revives a case challenging Medicaid limits for abortions](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=61b2f914ae&e=95417d7e87)(NPR)
* Pennsylvania's Supreme Court said Monday that a lower court must hear a challenge to the constitutionality of a decades-old state law that limits the use of Medicaid dollars to cover the cost of abortions, a major victory for Planned Parenthood and the abortion clinic operators who sued.

[A State Supreme Court Just Issued the Most Devastating Rebuke of Dobbs Yet](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=c60d229810&e=95417d7e87)(Slate)
* The Supreme Court’s eradication of the constitutional right to abortion in 2022’s Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization had an immediate and devastating impact on gender equality in the United States. With a single ruling, five justices wiped out millions of women’s access to basic health care and handed control over their medical decisions to politicians and judges.

[Trump asks U.S. Supreme Court to pause federal trial over presidential immunity question](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=90a68baf91&e=95417d7e87)(Penn Capital-Star)
* Former President Donald Trump asked the U.S. Supreme Court on Monday to further delay his federal criminal trial on charges he attempted to subvert the 2020 election, contending his actions were protected by presidential immunity.

Lastly, we can’t continue to do important work like Why Courts Matter without your support. To donate to these efforts, [click here](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=1f70081090&e=95417d7e87).
|
---
# NPP in the News
[Group pushes to register 60,000 new voters in Pennsylvania](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=7f10634d7d&e=95417d7e87)(Public News Service)
* The Keystone State's primary election is less than 90 days away, and a nonpartisan, grassroots organization is already getting the word out to residents about the importance of voting and voter registration.

|
---
# Social of the Week
| | | | [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=577bcbadce&e=95417d7e87)| [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=b433f84938&e=95417d7e87)| [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=00c837560a&e=95417d7e87)
---|---|---
|
---
# News You Can Use
[USPS investigated late mail-in ballots in Lancaster County; here's what it found](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=2b33d0b8ce&e=95417d7e87)(Lancaster Online)
* A United States Postal Service investigation has turned up no information about why 268 mail-in ballots took almost two weeks to arrive at the Lancaster County elections office, after the Nov. 7 general election deadline, a county commissioner said Tuesday.

[Pennsylvania automatic voter registration boosts sign-ups, but not a political party, data shows](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=887b26a46f&e=95417d7e87)(AP News)
* New data from automatic voter registration at Pennsylvania driver’s license centers shows that sign-ups have grown, remain almost evenly divided between the political parties and do not significantly favor one party over another in the presidential battleground state.

[A Lower Bucks special election will determine control of the Pa. House](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=ffb81e2383&e=95417d7e87)(The Philadelphia Inquirer)
* The balance of the Pennsylvania House is on the line for a fourth time in less than a year, with a special election next week in Lower Bucks County.

[What you need to know to vote in Pennsylvania’s April 2024 primary](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=58ebfb784f&e=95417d7e87)(The Philadelphia Inquirer)
* Voters in Iowa and New Hampshire weighed in this month on their preferred presidential nominees, and campaigning is underway in other early primary states.

[How Spotlight PA will cover Pennsylvania’s 2024 election](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=5224f59783&e=95417d7e87)(Spotlight PA)
* The 2024 presidential election will again make Pennsylvania a central focus of national politics. But voters here will also weigh in on critical state races that tend to get less attention despite the big impact these contests will have on the future of the commonwealth.

|
---
# Upcoming Events
Bucks County! Today is the day! If you live in Falls Township, Morrisville, Tullytown, or parts of Middletown, make sure you vote by 8PM tonight! If you need help finding your polling location or have questions about voting today, [click here](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=0ad2fe7464&e=95417d7e87).
|

# We’re Hiring!
The New Pennsylvania Project is a voting rights organization with a primary focus of registering communities of color and the youth to vote. We are looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help defend democracy by expanding the electorate.
* Regional Organizing Director: Suburban Philadelphia

To learn more about how to apply and review job descriptions with requirements and disclosed salary ranges, [please click here](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=9069269029&e=95417d7e87).
|
---
Thank you for taking the time to stay informed. We'll be back in two weeks with the latest edition. In solidarity,#TeamNPP

**I hate to be so blunt, but without your immediate support, I 'm afraid it could be all over for my campaign.**

The Democrats have momentum on their side after they won big last cycle. Now, Chuck Schumer and Senate Democrats are looking to EXPAND their Senate Majority no matter the cost.

They're targeting Republican-held seats like never before, and Tennessee is at the TOP of their wishlist.

_They 've already handpicked a radical SOCIALIST to try and defeat me. And helped her raise over $1,000,000!_

Let me be clear, if the Democrats flip Tennessee our path to winning back the Senate will vanish, AND they will gain all the momentum they need to push through their radical agenda.

**I need to know which patriots I can count on in the coming days. This is your biggest test yet. Will you stay true to your Republican values and help me hold the line even in the face of this challenge?**

I promise to maintain my resolve and never stop fighting, so I need to know today if I can count on your support.

_That 's really all there is to it._

**[My fight to protect the soul of this nation will never stop, but I need to know if you'll stand by my side.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/l41wC_2I4XAkldjjGr0rwQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnrmrKP0TSaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9idHZmL2Nhbi1pLWNvdW50LW9uLXlvdS8_cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMjEzX1BBLVJPTjIuMTEzNzEzX3QxNDQ4NDkyLTEwNDMmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjQwMjEzX1BBLVJPTjIuMTEzNzEzX3QxNDQ4NDkyLTEwNDMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9dHYtcm9uLTIwMjQwMjEzJnh1bnY9dHYtcm9uLTIwMjQwMjEzVwNzcGNCCmXDYNLLZaXBIKNSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA "My fight to protect the soul of this nation will never stop, but I need to know if you’ll stand by my side.")**

The simple action of joining my fight today will move mountains in my efforts to keep Tennessee RED, save the Conservative agenda, and send President Trump back to the White House.

Friend, Happy almost Valentine’s Day! I want to take a moment to appreciate how special Maryland is. Wherever you go, there’s something for everyone. You and your loved ones can catch a game at Camden Yards, visit the National Aquarium and grab some fresh crab cakes, learn about our rich history at our museums, spend time at the Eastern Shore beaches, or Western Maryland’s mountains — the possibilities are endless! I can’t think of a better way to celebrate our state than to share the love together. Maryland is such a diverse state, with so many things to do. I can’t name them all myself (as much as I’d love to try). That’s why I’m here to ask you, [**what’s your favorite thing about Maryland?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78957510/454978742/1221740555?source=em20240213&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDNlZGRkOC1iMGNhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=plaUMCYJanvaYDg5mvJcTDzW2NhSNWRfpns_-v59I64=&emci=4f3eddd8-b0ca-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=643eddd8-b0ca-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=24635485) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78957511/454978743/1221740555?source=em20240213&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDNlZGRkOC1iMGNhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=plaUMCYJanvaYDg5mvJcTDzW2NhSNWRfpns_-v59I64=&emci=4f3eddd8-b0ca-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=643eddd8-b0ca-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=24635485) Our state is so special, especially to me. Derek —
With one of our final fundraising deadlines tomorrow and our last Senate debate in one week, this is a busy stretch of our campaign.
On the one hand, I’m out on the road talking to as many voters as I can.
I’m hearing their stories and sharing my far-reaching and progressive plans to ease their burdens and make a difference in their lives.
But Derek, I’m also keeping a close eye on our fundraising efforts. With 3 weeks to reach undecided voters, and Californians voting now, we can’t afford to run low on resources to connect with folks.
And our upcoming fundraising deadline tomorrow is one of our last opportunities to demonstrate our momentum.
Falling short of our fundraising goals, especially in the first filing period after Republican Steve Garvey attacked me on the debate stage and again on _Fox News_ , could signal to MAGA Republicans that I’m vulnerable.
That’s why I’m asking:

**Peter, the housing crisis is _personal_ to me.** Personal enough that I just went to the Florida State Capitol myself to demand action – and I’m not stopping there.

Listen, I was priced out of my home while running for Congress, and was houseless for two months. When I made it to Congress and moved to D.C, I was denied from multiple apartment buildings because unfair housing policies tanked my credit. There was no way to win.

And it isn’t just me – this crisis is impacting my entire generation. Americans used to literally buy homes at my age. _Now, we can’t even afford to rent an apartment._

**Our housing system is clearly broken. But we don’t have to accept broken systems, or wait for Republicans who clearly don’t give a damn to change their tune. Housing IS a human right, and I won’t stop fighting until our basic needs are met.**

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: One year since the MSU shooting
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
#

Friend,
Today, one year since the mass shooting at Michigan State I am thinking of Arielle, Brian, and Alexandria, of their families, and join with the entire Michigan State University community to mourn that horrible day, as well as recognize the thoughtful determination Spartans have shown every day since to recover.
As we mark the first anniversary of the shooting, I took the morning to spend some time on campus, checking in with students, faculty and staff, and talking about what the past year has been like for all of us. That includes my own fantastic interns in Lansing, all of whom are MSU students, who joined me throughout the day.
There really isn’t a playbook for how to mark this kind of anniversary, so it was heartening to see so many people turn their emotions into action through the day of service activities offered at the Hannah Community Center and International Center. There were service projects to work on, art options, and even a Squishmallow exchange to provide some extra comfort. These activities really showcased what it means to be Spartan Strong.
As a Member of Congress who had not one but two school shootings in her district, I know far too well how these events last long beyond when the news cameras leave — and how it can rip a hole in the heart of a community that’s difficult to heal.
I’m also thinking about the law enforcement and first responders from our local departments and across the state who sped to campus to help and assisted in the hours-long manhunt, the staff at Sparrow Hospital that jumped into action to treat the wounded, and MSU leadership, led by interim President Teresa Woodruff, who quickly organized grief services and planned vigils for students to grieve as a community. One place that’s burned into my brain from that evening is sitting in the ops center at the East Lansing Police Department as the hours-long manhunt took place. It seemed fitting to go back and visit with them and city fire and other first responder leaders on duty that night, and thank them for their actions that evening – and in the grueling year since. We shouldn’t lose sight of the fact that there was only one group of leaders who were running toward the gunfire, not away from it. And that they, too, have had to process this tragedy.
And, most importantly, we can’t mark this anniversary without acknowledging the strength and activism we witnessed by students in the days, weeks and months after the shooting. Student leaders organized rallies and vigils both large and small, on campus and at our Capitol.
I have found that when students go through a traumatic incident, and they’re dealing with some form of post-traumatic stress, a fierce determination also develops to enact change through the power of their first-hand experience. I’ve taken solace in seeing students and young people become activists, interns, first responders, testify in Lansing, and even decide to make promoting gun safety a career. I know this generation of MSU students who lived through the shooting will carry their experience out into the world and use it for good.
We should also recognize the concrete change that has come from the shooting. Just five weeks later, the Michigan Legislature passed historic gun safety legislation in the wake of this tragedy. Many students and parents testified at the legislative hearings. And Governor Whitmer proudly signed those bills into law on MSU’s campus in April. They go into effect today.
While there’s more work to do, Michigan’s leaders are setting the standard for how to respond when our children are threatened in their sanctuaries. With legislation, with law, and through convictions in the courts. Taken together, Congress should take note and learn from that example.
I am now on my way back to Washington to continue representing the people of mid-Michigan in Congress, even if my heart is still with East Lansing. It’s hard to explain how much a tragedy like this impacts all of us. The common theme I heard from students and staff today was the way a mass shooting forever changes the very DNA of a community. We are still climbing our way back. #SpartanStrong.
Thank you for reading,
Elissa Slotkin

PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
P.O. Box 4145
East Lansing, MI 48826

body:

---
| | | **Reflecting on Our Values **
**This Ash Wednesday**
---

Dear Peter,
As we enter the season of Lent with the observance of Ash Wednesday, our campaign in Washington's 8th Congressional District pauses to reflect on the principles of humility, sacrifice, and renewal that guide us. This solemn day reminds us of the importance of faith in our lives and in the conservative values that guide our vision for a better future.

In this moment of contemplation and spiritual renewal, we recognize the role of faith in fostering a community and nation where traditional values are cherished and upheld. It is a time to remember the sacrifices made for us and to recommit ourselves to serving others with compassion and integrity.
---
| | | |
---
| We invite you to join us in this period of reflection by supporting our campaign. Your contribution will empower us to continue advocating for policies that promote family, faith, and freedom.
Together, we can ensure that our community remains a place where conservative values flourish and guide the way toward prosperity and peace.

Sincerely,

Carmen Goers

Next month, the ultraconservative Supreme Court will hear arguments on mifepristone, a safe and effective abortion pill that far-right groups are trying to take off the market. clean_body: During the last campaign, we got out-spent – by millions and millions of dollars. Hello, After the 2022 election, my husband Adam Frisch and I went to Washington for “freshman orientation” for new members of Congress. We still didn’t know whether or not Adam had defeated Lauren Boebert. We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes. = Ultimately, though, after all the votes were counted, Adam came up short. We lost to Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and with Lauren Boebert now out of the race, I know he can win this time. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022. During the last campaign, we got out-spent – by millions and millions of dollars. It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads. If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and win this critical seat, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now. _Why am I so hard on CEOs?_
I've been asked this a few times before, and I firmly believe that **we should hold CEOs accountable because their decisions affect all of us.**
* * *
How much CEOs pay their workers directly determines if income inequality continues to rise.
When companies make products that are unsafe--from cancer causing talc baby powder to lethal firearms--consumers pay the price.
When CEOs deny parents paid family leave and don't pay them enough to cover child care costs, we see parents, especially women, leave the workforce in record numbers.
When companies choose to give their top executives massive bonuses instead of investing in new research, our country loses out on innovation that can spur new medical treatments or green technology.
When Elon Musk or Mark Zuckerberg or Rupert Murdoch make decisions, they determine what information millions of Americans see.
When corporations evade their taxes, we lose revenue that we could invest in schools or roads or affordable housing.
And when Big Polluters make decisions that leave our air, water, and whole climate a mess, already disadvantaged communities often face the brunt of the pollution.
**Whether you work for a massive corporation or not, the decisions of executives affect you and your family.**
* * *
When I was questioning Jamie Dimon during a Congressional Hearing about the low pay for his Chase Bank tellers, what I found most irritating was that kept saying he "didn't know" how one of his employees could afford to live on the salary he paid. He hadn't thought about it, because he was too focused on his biggest shareholders.
**It 's Congress' job to represent the people who are screwed over by these greedy executives--and that's most of us.**
So yes, I am hard on CEOs. All of Congress should be, really. But this is what's wrong with Washington--most politicians are deeply dependent on corporate cash and big money donors.
Too many CEOs assume they can buy elections. Just today, a crypto super PAC spent $3 million on an ad that attempts to use misinformation to rig this election. **This super PAC is funded by crypto billionaires, who want to live oversight and regulation free, and it seems that Adam Schiff is their preferred candidate. **
I'll always stand up to executives and billionaires, but to make it to the U.S. Senate, I really could use your financial support right now.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/f4f8451d-8cdc-4fd9-b74c-38029260fbef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thanks so much for considering,
Katie

| | |

_**Matt Dolan Takes Strong Stand Against Senate Amnesty Bill That Fails to Seal Southern Border.**_
* In an [interview with The Cleveland Plain Dealer](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=3831b14f95274d6a9ed7e913251cfca7&_e=_EgexlNufDQdI0wg8umhyBgKntAaDR2i2wD6D1ztqhrTeqZW4GH5fK2MYIEYKT_vfUvyC7HYRKHZZ-xQZg4cyXsF64wGPeQOQqCTUe262OOcBF4sSn4sHKJxDqf4R1Vi1UD4kQSwx92cwcG6I1ftTFDZKE1Pi8yQhuBIBA_B9jBWci_LTpZ-6YmArmfhIpTcs7kHCJM6rNDADZKp0z3_DyVCnyCA1dO2q1FCPjE33IDHzWJ3HGtY-TzjHp9k8ck-6NLxWYvLyUTcuL1vz6SiP7kleODW_j4tbURUwaB_jRhm1-LtbIpp2JS5r-c8PmoHRHAv6hoO98GSIIwO17-a4gAd3UKSPCzJQdh6AOSTT342OACIAtQOjK8DVSIMcWBf), Matt Dolan took a bold stand against a Senate border security bill that would fail to seal the southern border.

* “I have said repeatedly that any national security supplemental must include substantive policy reforms that seal the border,” Dolan said. “While the Senate bill does include some defense measures along with much-needed assistance for allies abroad such as Israel and Ukraine, it lacks far too many safeguards that would end the current crisis, prevent amnesty and protect taxpayer money.”

* He continued: “The safety and security of America and her allies are at stake. The Senate should immediately get to work with the House to incorporate elements of House Resolution 2 [a border security plan passed by House Republicans] which will seal the border, stem the flow of illegal immigrants and end the present crisis.”

---
| | |
---
_**“Women for Matt” Coalition & State Endorsements Growing in Support of Matt.**_
* Ohio Republican women launched the “Women for Matt” Coalition January 17th to express that Matt Dolan is the candidate they most trust to represent Ohio families.

* “Women for Matt” consists of many notable public figures, such as Findlay Mayor Christina Muryn, Jane Portman, former Ohio Attorney General Betty Montgomery, State Senator Gayle Manning and many more.

* The coalition continues to grow and now consists of more than 160 women in all corners of the state.
