body:
and why I’d do it again
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/130?refcode=BAX_em_HHR_FR_MM1_20million_021324&t=1&akid=962%2E62735%2E3zl3CV)
I got a surprise phone call last October —
I wasn’t expecting it. I didn’t ask for it. But by the end of it, I had turned down a $20 million campaign contribution.
And Peter, I’d turn it down all over again.
Why? Because I meant it when I said this is a people-powered campaign. I won’t be bought, bossed, or bullied into compromising my principles, and I _damn sure_ am not going to run a campaign that takes marching orders from the ultra-rich.
No, I jumped into this race to represent working families and everyday Michiganders — _real people._ No one else.
But here’s the thing: Without grassroots support, I don’t stand a chance against those career politicians.
[**Can you chip in $20 to boost my campaign’s grassroots momentum? I’m counting on working folks like you to fuel our people-powered movement.**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/398?t=2&akid=962%2E62735%2E3zl3CV)
I’m no Washington insider — I’m a single dad, union organizer, and small business owner who has watched our current system fail working families over and over. At the core of it all are too many politicians in Washington, bought and paid for by the 1% and big industries, that don’t really care about putting people over their own payday.
So while we may not have the same financial muscle as Washington insiders, I know we’ve got something even better: A movement of everyday folks who are tired of our broken system, tired of dirty money in politics, and ready for dynamic change. **If that sounds like you, this is your invitation to join us, Peter.**
[**Look, I don’t expect my supporters to cut $20 million checks to my campaign — but I DO hope you’ll chip in $20 today to give me the grassroots firepower I need to win. I’m looking to raise $25,000 in online grassroots support by Thursday, so every dollar counts!**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/398?t=3&akid=962%2E62735%2E3zl3CV)
**[CHIP IN $20](https://act.hillharper.com/go/398?t=4&akid=962%2E62735%2E3zl3CV)**
**[CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.hillharper.com/go/407?t=5&akid=962%2E62735%2E3zl3CV)**
This is a movement built of, by, and for working Michiganders — and it’s going to stay that way through our victory on Election Day. Thanks so much for being part of the team.
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

body:
As a doctor, Black History Month is more than a history lesson. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78963084/454997802/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzY2E3MGI5Yi1jM2NhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YxTa20Z4abCkSONdJ5WorSwH_aFk2i5C6AyIHXTS1vA=&emci=901fc65c-a3c6-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=3ca70b9b-c3ca-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=15820338)
---
Peter,

As a doctor, Black History Month is _more_ than a history lesson. It's a time to celebrate Black Americans' impact on our country. It's also a time to remember our country's history when it comes to fighting for equality and justice for _every_ American, to celebrate the tremendous progress we’ve made in the past decades, and to think about how we can do better.

As a doctor, I've had a unique view of how disparities show up in our healthcare system. For example, the Black maternal mortality rate is nearly _three times_ that of white women. In emergency medicine, researchers found that Black children with acute appendicitis were less likely than their white peers to receive painkillers. This is not okay, Peter.

As doctors, leaders, neighbors, and community members, we must all commit ourselves to doing better.

Thank you,

Kim

clean_body: As a doctor, Black History Month is more than a history lesson. Peter, As a doctor, Black History Month is more than a history lesson. It's a time to celebrate Black Americans' impact on our country. It's also a time to remember our country's history when it comes to fighting for equality and justice for every American, to celebrate the tremendous progress we’ve made in the past decades, and to think about how we can do better. As a doctor, I've had a unique view of how disparities show up in our healthcare system. For example, the Black maternal mortality rate is nearly three times that of white women. In emergency medicine, researchers found that Black children with acute appendicitis were less likely than their white peers to receive painkillers. This is not okay, Peter. As doctors, leaders, neighbors, and community members, we must all commit ourselves to doing better. clean_body: News from the League | February 13, 2024 | Legislation League President and CEO Sam Hodder talks about how a climate bond is California's best chance to combat climate change while there's still time. The benefits will be felt across the state, including in our redwood forests. Conservation California Gov. Gavin Newsom used the background of the League’s Orick Mill Site in Humboldt County to announce a new state salmon protection initiative—one that highlights the kind of habitat restoration we’re activating there with the Yurok Tribe, state agencies, and other nonprofits. It’s a ... tree! A League colleague is expecting a baby soon, which inspired us to go down the delightful rabbit hole of redwood-themed baby names. And we figured, why not share our list? Maybe a few years from now, elementary schools will be full of little Sequoias and Murrelets. Adventure Writer Helena Guglielmino describes how snow camping in Yosemite National Park’s famous Mariposa Grove of Giant Sequoias left her gobsmacked. Watch her video, read about her journey, and plan your trip. Wildlife Wildlife cameras on the League’s Lost Coast Redwoods property show how animals are thriving in this now-protected forest. Check out the wild cameos by American black bears, Roosevelt elk, black-tailed deer, mountain lions, and more. Discovery Last year marked the beginning of limited visitor access to Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve, the 730-acre old-growth redwoods property acquired by the League in 2018. Guided hikes helped introduce diverse audiences to the wonders of the redwood forest. Fun Want to combine your love of the redwoods with your expressions of love for Valentine’s Day? Our forest creatures have the answer with these perfectly timed, 100% free-of-charge downloadable Valentine’s Day cards. clean_body: | = Peter, It’s no surprise that I disagree with Republicans on almost every issue. They want a national abortion ban, I want reproductive freedom for all. They want to gut Social Security and Medicare, I want to protect it. They want to make it harder to vote, I want to make sure you have the chance to cast your ballot. I could go on. But after last week, it’s clear that there’s an even bigger problem here: I think Senators should actually do their jobs. Republicans don’t. = | | = | = For months, Republicans have erupted in panic about the influx of migrants arriving in our country seeking a better life. They have demanded that Congress take immediate action. But after Democrats and Republicans worked for over a year to negotiate legislation that would finally address many flaws in our immigration system, they voted against it. They voted against the very thing they begged for. Why? Because Donald Trump recognized that doing nothing about immigration would make it easier to run his bigoted campaign than it would be to actually address the problem — so he demanded they vote it down. And just like that, this massive “crisis” was no longer a “crisis.” Poof. Make no mistake, I believe this legislation was far from perfect. But the American people don’t elect us to be perfect — they elect us to do our jobs. This legislation would have been the first time that the Senate actually did something about our broken immigration system, but because MAGA Republicans are wholly beholden to Donald Trump, they are making it impossible to get anything done. Friend, it’s Greg.

Two weeks ago marked the start of Black History Month — a time to honor and celebrate Black Americans and Black History.

From Theodore Berry, Cincinnati's first Black Mayor, to Marjorie Parham, the city's pioneering Black publisher, the legacies of Black Ohioans continue to shape and inspire our OH-01 community and beyond.

But as we celebrate Black History Month, we don’t just honor the past. **_We also continue to dedicate ourselves to building a truly fair and just nation for all._**

That work has never been more important, and I’m honored to play a part in it each and every day in Congress.

Thanks for all you do, and Happy Black History Month.

In solidarity,

_Greg_

Dear Peter,
Immigration is the #1 concern among voters, according to a recent public opinion poll.
Voters also say that President Biden’s open border policy has been a complete disaster.
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. couldn’t agree more.
Six months ago, RFK, Jr. visited the southern border in Yuma, Arizona. Last week, he returned to southern Arizona __to find the situation has become much worse__.
Fentanyl and methamphetamine flood our country, killing more and more Americans every day.
The worst kind of organized crime pours into our streets, towns, and cities.
Migrants are routinely robbed, raped, kidnapped, and sex trafficked.
Conscience demands we act immediately to stop the waves of illegal immigration so we can return to the orderly, lawful immigration policies our nation was founded upon.
The first step to end this crisis is to reassert control over our border . . . [which is exactly what RFK Jr. will do on his first day as President of the United States](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=crisis_2_13_24_email_1_1_nd&n=3).

[CONTRIBUTE $100 >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=100&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=crisis_2_13_24_email_1_1_nd&n=7)
[CONTRIBUTE $240 >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=240&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=crisis_2_13_24_email_1_1_nd&n=8)
Most Americans want Joe Biden to work with the Republicans to pass legislation that will immediately close the border.
So far, Biden has refused to act.
Donald Trump wants Republicans to kill this legislation so he can then blame Joe Biden while he’s campaigning this fall.
In other words: one presidential candidate doing nothing to close the border wants to criticize the other presidential candidate who is also doing nothing to close the border.
_It’s politics as usual._
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-fixable-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=crisis_2_13_24_email_1_1_nd&n=9)
RFK, Jr. visited Cochise County, Arizona this week to see firsthand the humanitarian crisis and the current administration’s egregious mismanagement of the situation at our southern border.
The victims of our open border policy are the immigrants themselves. Compassion and decency demand that we do not allow the current situation to continue.
That’s why we must act today! We deserve a president who will respond to this unsustainable crisis in our country.
[Your best gift today](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=crisis_2_13_24_email_1_1_nd&n=10) will help send a very powerful message that it’s time to put an end to politics as usual and roll up our sleeves and get to work.
Thank you for your commitment to Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.’s campaign for presidency. _We depend so heavily on your faithful, ongoing support and are so very grateful for your generosity._
Team Kennedy

https://www.mackenzieforcongress.com/

** THE MACKENZIE MINUTE
------------------------------------------------------------

Friends,

Thank you, thank you, thank you!

With the help of our amazing volunteers, #TeamMackenzie was able to file more than 3 times the amount of petitions required to get on the ballot!

And with so many people lending a hand, we were the first campaign in PA-7 to file to get on the ballot. Our army of petition circulators and volunteers helped us secure more signatures than many thought we would be able to file. The team effort shows what we can accomplish together, and it is a sign of our campaign’s strength!

Now the real campaigning starts...

We have under 10 weeks to get the job done and we need your help with a few more fun grassroots efforts.

If you are interested in joining our grassroots team, you can sign up here: https://forms.gle/qTdGfWkhGnUnSNWD7

I was also happy to be able to add another great endorsement this week.
* Lower Milford Township Supervisor Timothy Cougle - Endorsement
* WEEK IN REVIEW!

Thank you again to everyone who is working so hard to help us!

All the Best,

RYAN MACKENZIE

Lower Milford Township Supervisor Timothy Cougle - Endorsement

I am happy to receive the endorsement of another respected local leader: Lower Milford Township Supervisor Timothy Cougle. Tim is a newly elected Supervisor in Lower Milford Township and is already doing great work there. Tim said “Ryan has a proven record of results. I know he will continue to work for all of us in Washington D.C., and I am happy to support him.”

WEEK IN REVIEW!

I went to support President Trump at his recent NRA Rally at the Great American Outdoor Show.

I was also happy to join with my state House colleague, Representative Zach Mako, at a Coffee and Conversation Event in Northampton.

Thank you again to everyone around the 7th District who showed up to Petition Signing Events for our campaign. It was great to run into so many familiar faces, and meet many new people as well!

#TeamMackenzie and I continue to work hard every single day as we head toward the Primary on April 23rd, and then straight to the General Election in November! Growing up, my family never had it easy. But because my community made important, necessary investments in public education, I became the first person in my family to graduate from high school and college.
I started working at 12 years old cleaning houses — then bagged groceries, worked at a bagel shop and waited tables to put myself through school — all to have a chance to earn a better life.
But today, far too many of the opportunities that were open to me have only become further out-of-reach for many Colorado families.

| | Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jrFu9CAQBp8Gd1iwgLELF_-fk1NESp8q2oMlJjKHD3OxLk8f-RSl3RntN5jWJYb7yOx_BjBHvzEApv4xgOvbnsrtM70880UI4tfuNZmDwhMDqPeV_tTfLy0ljMtxtafGjyp4oRsapRW276zsVTOPZyOl0x2aoBxKDG7Q3p0HhegQAlITRxCgBUgFSikBLaLrPTrvSbiBrGZaPHZaTFSiQ7nVHUvJObUup2YZ51rX7RE2MZg2crdCLV7I53oYDCaPX9HzOZe8x_rNQyHyOXFHl0rl4F4Jb1FyGMBwHTzyIZjA0aAMQg-9MYKp6VbTe6WSmDrtRTZl9OselyVunWVafDwiXU4_AQAA__95AW4c)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... name: Medicare for All via Our Revolution
subject: Add your name: Is healthcare about stock buybacks or saving lives?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

Last week, Bernie called in the CEOs of Big Pharma companies to face
questions in front of the Senate HELP committee about sky-high prices for
life-saving medications, corporate stock buybacks and record corporate
profits.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14843?source=email-20240213&t=1011&akid=5331%2E5885482%2E9nXE9- ]Tweet from Bernie Sanders: The CEOs talked a lot about how much it costs to
develop a new drug. But what they did not want to talk about is that 14 major
pharmaceutical companies spent $87B more on stock buybacks and dividends over a
recent 10-year period than what they spent on research & development.

It’s no surprise: Big Pharma defended putting profits ahead of people. But
healthcare in America should be about health, not massive corporate
profits and CEO bonuses. Healthcare should be about saving lives, not
enriching shareholders with stock buybacks. That’s why we need Bernie’s
Medicare for All bill.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14843?source=email-20240213&t=1012&akid=5331%2E5885482%2E9nXE9- ]Add your name: We need Medicare for All in America! It’s time for
Bernie’s universal, guaranteed, free at the point of service health care
system.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14843?source=email-20240213&t=1013&akid=5331%2E5885482%2E9nXE9- ]ADD YOUR NAME

Not only are we being ripped off by giant pharma corporations, with
millions bankrupted, but people’s lives are being put at risk so Big
Pharma execs can buy another yacht. It’s sick.

During the hearing, Bernie broke down just one example of Big Pharma’s
greed — jacking up the price of a drug that helps prevents strokes so that
CEOs can continue raking in big bonuses and record profits:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14843?source=email-20240213&t=1014&akid=5331%2E5885482%2E9nXE9- ]Tweet from Bernie Sanders: Eliquis, a medicine that helps prevent strokes,
costs $7,100/year in the U.S. vs. $900/year in Canada. Today, the CEO of the
company that makes this lifesaving drug refused to commit to lowering its price
in the U.S. UNACCEPTABLE. To me and the American people

This is why anything short of Medicare for All won’t work. Health
insurance companies, Big Pharma, and hospital conglomerates will find ways
to profit unless we have single payer healthcare.

Healthcare is a human right, not something that should be denied to people
without the money to afford medication, a doctor visit, surgery,
chemotherapy, mental health treatment, or any other kind of care.

Bernie’s Medicare for All bill is the answer to ensuring everyone has the
health care they need. It’s the answer to the greed-driven insurance and
pharma companies who care about profits more than patients.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14843?source=email-20240213&t=1015&akid=5331%2E5885482%2E9nXE9- ]Put Big Pharma CEOs on notice: Sign on to Bernie’s Medicare for All
bill and the fight to continue building support for HEALTHCARE FOR
EVERYONE in 2024.

When we organize, we win.
